S01E01.title: Lost and Found
S01E01.hook: 一只小蓝鸟又冷又怕，Dora 和 Boots 要送她回到妈妈身边。

cells.en: “Peep, peep, peep!” Someone is crying behind the flowers.
cells.cn: “啾、啾、啾！”花丛后面有谁在哭。

cells.en: A little blue bird sits on the grass. “She is cold,” says Boots.
cells.cn: 一只小蓝鸟坐在草地上，Boots 说：“她好冷呀。”

cells.en: “Now she's lost,” says Dora. They must find her mommy.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“她走丢了。”他们得帮她找到妈妈。

cells.en: “First the Cornfield, then the Big Tree,” says Boots.
cells.cn: Boots 说：“先过玉米地，再到那棵大树。”

cells.en: “Dora and Boots, all right!” They start walking down the path.
cells.cn: “Dora 和 Boots，出发！”他们沿着小路往前走。

cells.en: “Help us stop Swiper!” Dora needs you to say “Swiper, no swiping!”
cells.cn: “帮我们拦住 Swiper！”Dora 要你一起喊：“Swiper，不许抢！”

cells.en: “We're almost there!” The Little Blue Tree is past the fence.
cells.cn: “我们快到了！”小蓝树就在篱笆那边。

cells.en: Swiper grabs a yellow flower. “He wants to swipe her flower!”
cells.cn: Swiper 伸手去抓那朵黄花：“他想把她的花抢走！”

cells.en: “Muchas gracias!” The little bird is back with her mommy at last.
cells.cn: “非常感谢！”小蓝鸟终于回到妈妈身边了。

S01E01.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Lost and Found”.
S01E01.ending: In the end, the little blue bird finds her mommy. My favorite part is ______.

S01E02.title: The Big Red Chicken
S01E02.hook: 故事书里的大红鸡跑丢了，Dora 和 Boots 要走过木桥、推开大门，上大红山把它找回来。

cells.en: Dora reads a book about a little red chicken.
cells.cn: Dora 翻开故事书，书里讲的是一只小红鸡。

cells.en: The map shows three stops: the bridge, the gate, and the hill.
cells.cn: 书页上画着三站：木桥、大门、大红山。

cells.en: Swiper the fox tries to swipe, but they shout, “No swiping!”
cells.cn: 狐狸 Swiper 想抢东西，大家一喊，他只好认输。

cells.en: The bridge has a big hole. “Do you see anyone who can help us?”
cells.cn: 木桥中间破了个洞：“你看到有谁能帮我们吗？”

cells.en: The toucan brings a small plank. “Pequeño means small,” says Dora.
cells.cn: 鹦鹉叼来一块小木板：“Pequeño 就是‘小’的意思。”

cells.en: Dora pulls the gate, but it does not open. “It is locked!”
cells.cn: Dora 用力拉大门，可是门开不了：“门锁上了！”

cells.en: Dora holds a big bunch of keys. “One, two, three!”
cells.cn: Dora 抱来一大串钥匙：“一、二、三！”

cells.en: “Look, I can see the Big Red Hill!” They run down the path.
cells.cn: “看，我能看见大红山了！”他们沿着小路跑过去。

cells.en: “¡Lo hicimos!” They meet the Big Red Chicken on the hill.
cells.cn: “¡Lo hicimos！（我们做到啦！）”他们在大红山上见到了大红鸡。

S01E02.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Big Red Chicken”.
S01E02.ending: In the end, Dora and Boots meet the Big Red Chicken on the red hill. My favorite part is ______.

S01E03.title: Choo Choo
S01E03.hook: 小蓝火车 Azul 没有哨子，Dora 和 Boots 要陪它开到大黄车站去领哨子。

cells.en: The little blue train has no whistle. “He doesn't have a whistle!”
cells.cn: 小蓝火车没有哨子：“它没有哨子呀！”

cells.en: “We go to the Big Yellow Station.” The map shows a tunnel first.
cells.cn: “我们要去大黄车站。”地图上说，先要穿过隧道。

cells.en: “Chuga-chuga, choo choo!” Dora and Boots ride the blue train.
cells.cn: “咔嚓咔嚓，呜呜！”Dora 和 Boots 坐上蓝色小火车。

cells.en: “We won't be able to see where we're going!” Inside it is dark.
cells.cn: “我们都看不见路啦！”隧道里面黑黑的。

cells.en: Swiper grabs the tracks. “Swiper, no!” Dora and Boots shout.
cells.cn: Swiper 把铁轨抢走了，Dora 和 Boots 大喊：“Swiper，不行！”

cells.en: “Will you help us find the missing tracks?” asks Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 问：“你愿意帮我们找回不见的铁轨吗？”

cells.en: “It's a square, but it's not blue.” They find the right piece.
cells.cn: “是方形的，可不是蓝色。”他们找到了对的那一块。

cells.en: The octopus gives Azul a big whistle. “Wow, that's a big whistle!”
cells.cn: 章鱼站长送给 Azul 一个大哨子：“哇，好大的哨子！”

cells.en: “Choo choo!” Azul toots his big new whistle at the station.
cells.cn: “呜呜！”Azul 在车站吹响了它的新哨子。

S01E03.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Choo Choo”.
S01E03.ending: In the end, the little blue train toots his big new whistle. My favorite part is ______.

S01E04.title: Hic-Boom-Ohhh
S01E04.hook: 森林里传来“嗝——轰——哦”的怪声，Dora 和 Boots 要找出声音是从哪儿来的。

cells.en: Dora and Boots hear a loud sound. “Let's find the sound!”
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 听到一个很响的声音：“我们去找找这个声音！”

cells.en: “River, forest, golden hills.” The map shows the way to go.
cells.cn: “小河、森林、金色山丘。”地图指出了要走的三个地方。

cells.en: “¡Azul! ¡Azul!” A blue boat comes to take them across.
cells.cn: “¡Azul！（蓝色！）”一艘蓝色小船过来载他们过河。

cells.en: “Oh, no! It's Swiper the sneaky fox.” He wants their stuff.
cells.cn: “糟糕！是狡猾的狐狸 Swiper。”他想抢走他们的东西。

cells.en: “If we all do the tiptoe walk,” they can pass very quietly.
cells.cn: “我们一起踮着脚走，”他们就能悄悄地过去。

cells.en: “Maybe it's a sleeping giant,” says Boots in the quiet forest.
cells.cn: Boots 在安静的森林里小声说：“说不定是睡着的大巨人。”

cells.en: “Hic... boom... oh!” The sound comes again and again.
cells.cn: “嗝……轰……哦！”那个声音一遍又一遍地响。

cells.en: “Count to ten in a really loud voice,” says the blue cow.
cells.cn: 蓝牛说：“用很大的声音一起数到十。”

cells.en: “¡Lo hicimos!” The big hiccups are gone at last.
cells.cn: “¡Lo hicimos！（我们做到啦！）”大嗝终于停下来了。

S01E04.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Hic-Boom-Ohhh”.
S01E04.ending: In the end, the loud counting stops the big hiccups. My favorite part is ______.

S01E05.title: Ice Cream
S01E05.hook: 冰淇淋车开走了！Dora 和 Boots 要先上草莓山、再划过巧克力湖，才能到冰淇淋岛。

cells.en: “I love ice cream!” Boots smiles and jumps with Dora.
cells.cn: “我爱冰淇淋！”Boots 笑着和 Dora 一起跳。

cells.en: “Uh-oh! I think the truck is leaving!” The white truck drives away.
cells.cn: “哎呀！冰淇淋车好像要开走了！”白色的小车开远了。

cells.en: The map shows three places. “First, Strawberry Mountain,” says Dora.
cells.cn: 地图上有三个地方。Dora 说：“先过草莓山。”

cells.en: “Tico, can you give us a ride?” Tico honks his horn.
cells.cn: “Tico，你能载我们一程吗？”Tico 按了按喇叭。

cells.en: The little yellow car climbs up and over the mountain.
cells.cn: 黄色的小车爬上山顶，翻过了山。

cells.en: “The chocolate boat!” Boots points at a boat on the brown lake.
cells.cn: “巧克力船！”Boots 指着棕色湖面上的一条船。

cells.en: “Will you help us row across the lake?” asks Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 问：“你愿意帮我们划过这个湖吗？”

cells.en: “Now we can get ice cream!” Dora holds a big pink cone.
cells.cn: “现在我们能买冰淇淋啦！”Dora 举起一个大大的粉色甜筒。

cells.en: “Now help me count out eight coins,” says Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“现在帮我数出八枚硬币。”

S01E05.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Ice Cream”.
S01E05.ending: In the end, Dora and Boots buy ice cream with eight coins. My favorite part is ______.

S01E06.title: Three L'il Piggies
S01E06.hook: 三只小猪戴着蓝丝带跑丢啦！Dora 和 Boots 要去干草堆、谷仓和苹果树把它们找回来。

cells.en: “Aw, piggies!” The three little piggies run out of the house.
cells.cn: “哎呀，小猪们！”三只小猪从屋里跑了出去。

cells.en: Dora wants you to find the blue ribbons for the little piggies.
cells.cn: Dora 想请你帮小猪们找回蓝丝带。

cells.en: “Hay, Barn, Apple Tree,” says the Map. That is the way to go.
cells.cn: 地图说：“干草堆、谷仓、苹果树。”就按这条路走。

cells.en: “The hay is moving!” One little piggy hides under the hay.
cells.cn: “干草在动！”一只小猪藏在干草堆下面。

cells.en: “Abre!” says Dora. “Abre” is Spanish for “open the door.”
cells.cn: Dora 说：“Abre！”Abre 是西班牙语的“开门”。

cells.en: “Where's the apple tree?” asks Boots. They look for it together.
cells.cn: Boots 问：“苹果树在哪里？”他们一起找苹果树。

cells.en: The wagon is stuck in the mud. “Will you help us pull it out?”
cells.cn: 小车陷进泥里了。“你愿意帮我们把它拉出来吗？”

cells.en: Here comes Swiper the fox! “Say ‘Swiper, no swiping!’”
cells.cn: 捣蛋鬼狐狸 Swiper 来了！“快说‘Swiper，不许抢！’”

cells.en: “Oinkie fell from the apple tree!” Now all three piggies are safe.
cells.cn: “Oinkie 从苹果树上掉下来啦！”现在三只小猪都安全了。

S01E06.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Three L'il Piggies”.
S01E06.ending: In the end, all three piggies go back home safe. My favorite part is ______.

S01E07.title: Treasure Island
S01E07.hook: 海盗鹦鹉带来一张藏宝图！Dora 和 Boots 要找到蓝钥匙，去宝藏岛挖出宝箱。

cells.en: “I spy a pirate parrot!” He flies in with a treasure chest.
cells.cn: “我发现了一只海盗鹦鹉！”他带着宝箱飞了进来。

cells.en: “We don't know where the treasure chest is,” says Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“我们不知道宝箱在哪里。”

cells.en: The Map says: “Tree, Lake, Treasure Island.” Off they go!
cells.cn: 地图说：“大树、湖、宝藏岛。”出发！

cells.en: “We found the blue key!” Dora and Boots hold it up high.
cells.cn: “我们找到蓝钥匙啦！”Dora 和 Boots 把它高高举起。

cells.en: A big iguana says “grande, grande!” Grande means very big.
cells.cn: 一只大鬣蜥说“grande, grande！”grande 就是“很大”的意思。

cells.en: “Ah! The blue key!” Swiper wants to swipe it from them.
cells.cn: “啊！蓝钥匙！”Swiper 想把它抢走。

cells.en: “You tell me if you see an ‘X’,” says Dora on the sand.
cells.cn: Dora 在沙滩上说：“看到‘X’就告诉我。”

cells.en: “First put your hands out in front of you.” They dig and dig.
cells.cn: “先把双手伸到前面。”他们挖呀挖呀挖。

cells.en: “The treasure chest!” At last they open it on Treasure Island.
cells.cn: “宝箱！”他们终于在宝藏岛上打开了它。

S01E07.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Treasure Island”.
S01E07.ending: In the end, Dora and Boots open the treasure chest. My favorite part is ______.

S01E08.title: Beaches
S01E08.hook: Dora 带着礼物游泳圈去海滩找 Boots，Swiper 却把礼物扔丢了！

cells.en: “I'm going swimming at the beach,” says Dora. She has a present.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“我要去海边游泳。”她带了一份礼物。

cells.en: The present is a floaty. “It's got a red bow on it.”
cells.cn: 礼物是个游泳圈。“上面系着一个红蝴蝶结。”

cells.en: The Map shows: “Over the dunes, then down the boardwalk.”
cells.cn: 地图指路：“先翻过沙丘，再沿着木板路走。”

cells.en: “It's the fox!” They see Swiper and yell at him together.
cells.cn: “是那只狐狸！”他们看见了 Swiper，一起冲他大喊。

cells.en: “The dunes really are big hills of sand.” Dora climbs up.
cells.cn: “沙丘真是好大的沙山。”Dora 往上爬。

cells.en: “Do you see the boardwalk?” Dora points to the way.
cells.cn: “你看到木板路了吗？”Dora 指着要走的路。

cells.en: “Let's see how many boards we need,” says Dora. Count with her!
cells.cn: Dora 说：“看看我们需要几块木板。”跟她一起数吧！

cells.en: Swiper threw the floaty far away. “We'll find it!” says Dora.
cells.cn: Swiper 把游泳圈扔远了。Dora 说：“我们会找到它的！”

cells.en: “Look, Dora, I'm swimming with my new floaty!” says Boots.
cells.cn: Boots 说：“看，Dora，我戴着新游泳圈在游泳啦！”

S01E08.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Beaches”.
S01E08.ending: In the end, Boots swims in the sea with his new floaty. My favorite part is ______.

S01E09.title: Big River
S01E09.hook: Boots 的红靴子被河水冲走了，Dora 和他坐上小船，一路划过大河去追它。

cells.en: Dora stands on the dock and fishes. Fish jump up. “Yeah, there's some!”
cells.cn: Dora 站在码头上钓鱼，小鱼一条条蹦起来：“对，有鱼！”

cells.en: “Dora, my boot is floating away!” The red boot drifts down the river.
cells.cn: “Dora，我的靴子漂走了！”红靴子顺着大河漂下去。

cells.en: “My boot! My boot!” Boots cries. They run after the little red boot.
cells.cn: “我的靴子！我的靴子！”Boots 大叫，他们追着那只小红靴跑。

cells.en: “Look, there's your boot!” Dora and Boots row their boat to the bridge.
cells.cn: “看，你的靴子在那儿！”Dora 和 Boots 划着小船来到桥边。

cells.en: “We go past all those branches!” Dora and Boots row very fast.
cells.cn: “我们穿过那些树枝啦！”Dora 和 Boots 飞快地划船。

cells.en: Boots sees the big waterfall. “Oh, no!” The water is very loud.
cells.cn: Boots 看见前面的大瀑布：“糟糕！”水声好响。

cells.en: “We make it past the waterfall!” Dora and Boots cheer in the boat.
cells.cn: “我们冲过瀑布啦！”Dora 和 Boots 在船上欢呼。

cells.en: Dora holds a fishing rod. “Come on, Boots!” They row to the red boot.
cells.cn: Dora 拿着鱼竿：“来吧，Boots！”他们朝红靴子划过去。

cells.en: “But we found it!” Boots has his red boots on again.
cells.cn: “可是我们找到它啦！”Boots 的红靴子又穿回脚上了。

S01E09.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Big River”.
S01E09.ending: In the end, Boots gets his red boot back. My favorite part is ______.

S01E10.title: WizzleWishes
S01E10.hook: Dora 从《许愿书》里请出了小精灵 Wizzle，要把他送回家，还得先躲过捣蛋鬼 Swiper。

cells.en: Dora makes a wish. She wants her friend Boots to come.
cells.cn: Dora 许下一个愿望，她希望好朋友 Boots 来找她。

cells.en: Dora reads a book about wishes. A little Wizzle lives inside it.
cells.cn: Dora 读一本关于许愿的书，书里住着一只小精灵 Wizzle。

cells.en: A yellow Wizzle jumps out of the book. “Count with us!”
cells.cn: 一只黄色的小精灵从书里跳出来：“和我们一起数！”

cells.en: “We're going to keep going!” Dora, Boots and the Wizzle walk on.
cells.cn: “我们要一直往前走！”Dora、Boots 和小精灵继续赶路。

cells.en: Squirrels love nuts. They sit under the big trees and eat.
cells.cn: 松鼠最爱坚果，它们坐在大树下啃个不停。

cells.en: “Right! There they are!” The blue house sits on top of the hill.
cells.cn: “对！就在那儿！”那栋蓝色的小房子就在山顶上。

cells.en: Swiper the fox comes to the well. “Swiper, no swiping!”
cells.cn: 狐狸 Swiper 溜到井边来，大家齐声喊：“Swiper，不许抢！”

cells.en: Dora opens the book again. “I wish the Wizzle home!”
cells.cn: Dora 又翻开那本书：“我希望小精灵回家！”

cells.en: The Wizzle is home with his mommy and daddy. Dora and Boots wave.
cells.cn: 小精灵回到了爸爸妈妈身边，Dora 和 Boots 向他挥手。

S01E10.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “WizzleWishes”.
S01E10.ending: In the end, the Wizzle is home with his family. My favorite part is ______.

S01E11.title: Berry Hunt
S01E11.hook: Dora 想去蓝莓山采蓝莓，路上要划船过河、穿过刺刺森林，还遇上一头大熊！

cells.en: Dora shows her blueberries. “Look what my mommy gave me for a snack!”
cells.cn: Dora 拿出她的蓝莓：“看，妈妈给我带了什么点心！”

cells.en: The Map shows the way: “First the river, then the Prickly Forest!”
cells.cn: 地图指出路线：“先过河，再穿过刺刺森林！”

cells.en: Dora and Boots sit in the boat. “Row, row, row!” across the river.
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 坐上小船：“划呀，划呀，划！”过河。

cells.en: The forest is full of thorns. “Let's stop and think,” says Dora.
cells.cn: 森林里全是刺。Dora 说：“停一停，想一想。”

cells.en: “Abre!” says Dora, and the gate opens. They walk through the forest.
cells.cn: Dora 喊“Abre（打开）！”，门开了，他们穿过森林。

cells.en: They climb Blueberry Hill. “Do you see the blueberries?” asks Dora.
cells.cn: 他们爬上蓝莓山。Dora 问：“你们看到蓝莓了吗？”

cells.en: Here comes Swiper! “He'll try to swipe our blueberries!”
cells.cn: Swiper 来啦！“他想偷拿我们的蓝莓！”

cells.en: A big bear runs after them. “Grab onto a vine!” Dora shouts.
cells.cn: 一头大熊追来啦！Dora 大喊：“快抓住藤蔓！”

cells.en: “We had such an exciting berry hunt!” The pail is full of blueberries.
cells.cn: “多刺激的采莓之旅呀！”小桶里装满了蓝莓。

S01E11.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Berry Hunt”.
S01E11.ending: In the end, Dora and Boots fill the pail with blueberries and go home. My favorite part is ______.

S01E12.title: Surprise
S01E12.hook: 今天是 Boots 的生日！Dora 带他去派对屋，可 Swiper 把蛋糕藏起来了。

cells.en: Dora looks for Boots. “Now where is that little monkey?”
cells.cn: Dora 在找 Boots：“这只小猴子到底在哪儿呀？”

cells.en: “Feliz” means “happy”. Dora asks Boots to say “feliz birthday”!
cells.cn: “Feliz”是“快乐”的意思。Dora 请 Boots 说“feliz birthday”！

cells.en: The Map says: “Stairs, Bridge, Party House!” That is the way.
cells.cn: 地图说：“台阶、桥、派对屋！”就按这条路走。

cells.en: Dora rides a caballito. “That's caballito — a little horse!”
cells.cn: Dora 骑着小木马：“这是 caballito——小木马！”

cells.en: They climb the big stairs. “Happy, happy birthday!” they sing.
cells.cn: 他们爬上大台阶，唱起歌：“生日快乐，快乐！”

cells.en: Swiper hides the birthday cake! “You'll never find it now!”
cells.cn: Swiper 把生日蛋糕藏起来啦：“这下你们别想找到它！”

cells.en: The Grumpy Old Troll lives under the bridge. He sings a funny song.
cells.cn: 爱生气的老巨魔住在桥底下，唱起一首搞笑的歌。

cells.en: The party is at the Party House. Boots gets colorful goody bags!
cells.cn: 派对屋里的派对开始啦，Boots 拿到五颜六色的礼物袋！

cells.en: It is time to sing “Feliz Cumpleaños” to Boots at the party.
cells.cn: 到了给 Boots 唱《Feliz Cumpleaños（生日快乐）》的时候啦。

S01E12.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Surprise”.
S01E12.ending: In the end, Boots has a happy birthday party with all his friends. My favorite part is ______.

S01E13.title: Grandma's House
S01E13.hook: 奶奶感冒了！Dora 和 Boots 带着一篮点心去看她，Swiper 却一路来捣乱。

cells.en: Dora's grandma is sneezing and coughing. She has a bad cold.
cells.cn: Dora 的奶奶又打喷嚏又咳嗽，她感冒了。

cells.en: Dora asks, “Will you help me take the basket of treats?”
cells.cn: Dora 问：“你愿意帮我带上这篮点心吗？”

cells.en: The Map knows the quickest way to Grandma's house.
cells.cn: 地图知道去奶奶家最近的路。

cells.en: Swiper tries to swipe the basket! “Swiper, no swiping!” they say.
cells.cn: Swiper 想抢篮子！他们喊：“Swiper，不许抢！”

cells.en: Swiper throws the basket away. “We'll get the basket back!”
cells.cn: Swiper 把篮子扔了出去。“我们一定要把篮子拿回来！”

cells.en: Swiper swings at them from the trees. “Help us duck down!”
cells.cn: Swiper 从树上朝他们荡过来。“帮我们低头躲开！”

cells.en: Dora counts in Spanish. “Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco!”
cells.cn: Dora 用西班牙语数数：“一、二、三、四、五！”

cells.en: Swiper comes back again! Dora and Boots say, “Swiper, no swiping!”
cells.cn: Swiper 又来啦！Dora 和 Boots 喊：“Swiper，不许抢！”

cells.en: Abuela eats the treats and says, “I'm feeling better already.”
cells.cn: 奶奶吃着点心说：“我已经感觉好多了。”

S01E13.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Grandma's House”.
S01E13.ending: In the end, Abuela eats the treats and feels much better. My favorite part is ______.

S01E14.title: Sticky Tape
S01E14.hook: Benny 的热气球破了个洞！Dora 和 Boots 要把粘胶带送去给他修气球。

cells.en: Dora and Boots hear a voice from the sky. “A balloon!”
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 听到天上有声音。“是热气球！”

cells.en: The balloon has a hole. Benny needs sticky tape to fix it.
cells.cn: 气球破了个洞，Benny 需要粘胶带来修它。

cells.en: To find Benny, Dora and Boots say, “Map!”
cells.cn: 为了找到 Benny，Dora 和 Boots 喊：“地图！”

cells.en: First the river, then the rock, then Crocodile Lake.
cells.cn: 先过河，再经过大石头，最后到鳄鱼湖。

cells.en: Dora asks Tico in Spanish, “¿Puedes llevarnos al otro lado del río?”
cells.cn: Dora 用西班牙语问 Tico：“你能带我们到河对岸吗？”

cells.en: Tico speaks Spanish, so Dora and Boots count in Spanish.
cells.cn: Tico 说西班牙语，所以 Dora 和 Boots 用西班牙语数数。

cells.en: “You see Swiper?” asks Boots. Swiper is hiding near the rock.
cells.cn: Boots 问：“你看见 Swiper 了吗？”Swiper 躲在石头附近。

cells.en: Benny's balloon is high up. “Will you help us climb the ladder?”
cells.cn: Benny 的气球在高处。“你愿意帮我们爬上梯子吗？”

cells.en: Dora puts sticky tape on the hole. “Good climbing!” says Benny.
cells.cn: Dora 把粘胶带贴在洞上。Benny 说：“爬得真好！”

S01E14.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Sticky Tape”.
S01E14.ending: In the end, the sticky tape fixes Benny's balloon. My favorite part is ______.

S01E15.title: Bouncing Ball
S01E15.hook: Boots 的新弹力球蹦走了！Dora 和 Boots 追着球过了巨魔桥，一直追到火山口。

cells.en: Dora asks Boots, “What kind of ball do you want to get?”
cells.cn: Dora 问 Boots：“你想要买哪种球呀？”

cells.en: Dora has some coins in her backpack to buy the ball.
cells.cn: Dora 的背包里有硬币，可以买球。

cells.en: Boots throws the ball, and it bounces away with all the coins!
cells.cn: Boots 一扔，球带着所有硬币蹦走啦！

cells.en: “I love my ball, my bouncy ball!” sings Boots.
cells.cn: Boots 唱着：“我爱我的球，我的弹力球！”

cells.en: The ball keeps bouncing. Dora and Boots must get to the volcano.
cells.cn: 球一直往前蹦。Dora 和 Boots 必须赶到火山去。

cells.en: On the way to the volcano, they cross the Troll Bridge.
cells.cn: 去火山的路上，他们要过巨魔桥。

cells.en: Swiper wants their ball! “Swiper, no swiping!” they say.
cells.cn: Swiper 想抢他们的球！他们喊：“Swiper，不许抢！”

cells.en: Their friend Tico the squirrel drives them up the volcano.
cells.cn: 他们的朋友小松鼠 Tico 开车带他们上火山。

cells.en: They get the bouncy ball back. “We couldn't have done it without you!”
cells.cn: 他们拿回了弹力球。“没有你可做不到！”

S01E15.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Bouncing Ball”.
S01E15.ending: In the end, Boots gets his bouncy ball back. My favorite part is ______.

S01E16.title: Bugga Bugga
S01E16.hook: 一阵大风吹散了虫虫妈妈和她的饼干，Dora 和 Boots 要送虫虫妈妈回蓝灌木丛喂宝宝。

cells.en: Dora and Boots look at the little bugs, just like the ones in her bug book.
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 在观察小虫子，就像她虫子书里画的一样。

cells.en: “I've got to get home to feed my little babies!” says Mami Bugga Bugga.
cells.cn: 虫虫妈妈说：“我得回家喂我的小宝宝们！”

cells.en: “Let's take the cookie to the babies,” says Dora. They will help Mami.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“我们把这块饼干送去给宝宝们吧。”他们要帮虫虫妈妈。

cells.en: They have to say “Abre” to open the flower in the Flowery Garden.
cells.cn: 他们得喊“Abre（打开）”才能让花园里的花开。

cells.en: It is the Spider Web! Boots steps in and gets stuck.
cells.cn: 是蜘蛛网！Boots 一脚踩上去被粘住了。

cells.en: “We need to find a path,” says Boots. They look for the way out.
cells.cn: Boots 说：“我们得找到一条小路。”他们寻找出路。

cells.en: “Now, where's the Big Blue Bush?” asks Dora. Can you see it?
cells.cn: Dora 问：“现在，大蓝灌木丛在哪儿呀？”你看见了吗？

cells.en: “I'm home! I'm home!” Mami Bugga Bugga flies to her babies.
cells.cn: “到家啦！到家啦！”虫虫妈妈飞向她的宝宝们。

cells.en: “Yay!” The ten little babies eat the cookie and say “Gracias.”
cells.cn: “耶！”十个小宝宝吃着饼干说“谢谢（Gracias）”。

S01E16.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Bugga Bugga”.
S01E16.ending: In the end, Mami Bugga Bugga gets home and feeds her ten little babies. My favorite part is ______.

S01E17.title: Fish Out of Water
S01E17.hook: 一条小红鱼被困在沙滩的小水洼里，Dora 和 Boots 要把他送回大海找家人。

cells.en: Dora and Boots look for seashells on the sand. “Do you see any seashells?”
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 在沙滩上找贝壳：“你看到贝壳了吗？”

cells.en: A little red fish is in a small pool. “I've got to get home.”
cells.cn: 一条小红鱼被困在小水洼里：“我得回家。”

cells.en: The Map says, “First you go past the sand castle.”
cells.cn: 地图说：“先走过那座沙堡。”

cells.en: Dora and Boots carry the fish in a bucket. “I see it!”
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 用小桶提着小鱼：“我看见沙堡了！”

cells.en: “We're taking this baby red fish back to his family,” says Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“我们要把这条小红鱼宝宝送回家人身边。”

cells.en: They walk over the dunes. “Now, where's the ocean?”
cells.cn: 他们翻过沙丘：“现在大海在哪儿呢？”

cells.en: “Look! We made it to the ocean!” says Dora. Boots jumps up.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“看！我们到大海了！”Boots 高兴地跳起来。

cells.en: A yellow submarine goes down. “Whoa!” say Dora and Boots.
cells.cn: 一艘黄色潜水艇往下沉：“哇！”Dora 和 Boots 一起惊叹。

cells.en: The red fish is home. They sing, “We did it!”
cells.cn: 小红鱼回到家了，大家唱起歌：“我们做到了！”

S01E17.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Fish Out of Water”.
S01E17.ending: In the end, the little red fish is home with his family. My favorite part is ______.

S01E18.title: El Coqui
S01E18.hook: 书里的小科基蛙想回到美丽的小岛，Dora 和 Boots 带他穿过回声灌木丛，再坐船过海。

cells.en: Dora shows Boots a picture in her book. “Luna Guitarra!”
cells.cn: Dora 给 Boots 看书里的一幅画：“月亮吉他！”

cells.en: “That coquí lives on a beautiful island,” Dora reads to Boots.
cells.cn: Dora 念给 Boots 听：“这只科基蛙住在一座美丽的小岛上。”

cells.en: “First we have to find the Echo Bush,” says Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“我们先要找到回声灌木丛。”

cells.en: “Don't worry, Coquí, we're almost there,” says Boots.
cells.cn: Boots 说：“别担心，科基，我们快到了。”

cells.en: The Echo Bush says it back. “Yeah, who's talking?”
cells.cn: 回声灌木丛把话学回来：“对呀，是谁在说话？”

cells.en: They walk to the shore. “Now, where is the ocean?”
cells.cn: 他们走到岸边：“现在大海在哪儿呢？”

cells.en: On the little boat Dora says, “We're going to have you home soon, Coquí!”
cells.cn: 小船上，Dora 说：“我们很快就送你回家，科基！”

cells.en: “I know! We can jump like Coquí,” says Boots on the rocks.
cells.cn: Boots 站在礁石上说：“我知道了！我们可以像科基那样跳。”

cells.en: The coquí family sings in the tree. “Coquí! Qui! Qui!”
cells.cn: 科基蛙一家在树上唱歌：“科基！叽！叽！”

S01E18.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “El Coqui”.
S01E18.ending: In the end, the little coquí sings with his family in the tree. My favorite part is ______.

S01E19.title: The Chocolate Tree
S01E19.hook: Abuela 奶奶想念小时候的巧克力树，Dora 和 Boots 穿过丛林，去找那棵会唱歌的巧克力树。

cells.en: Abuela says, “This tree was mi querido amigo, my dear friend.”
cells.cn: Abuela 奶奶说：“这棵树是我亲爱的朋友。”

cells.en: Abuela moved far away and misses the Chocolate Tree.
cells.cn: Abuela 搬到了很远的地方，她想念巧克力树。

cells.en: The Map says, “First you go through the Jungle, then the Cave.”
cells.cn: 地图说：“先穿过丛林，然后到山洞。”

cells.en: “So first we have to find the Jungle,” says Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“所以我们先要找到丛林。”

cells.en: Five snapping turtles sit on the path. Dora counts them all.
cells.cn: 路上坐着五只咬人龟，Dora 把它们一只只数出来。

cells.en: “How many crocodiles are there?” They must cross Crocodile Lake.
cells.cn: “有多少只鳄鱼？”他们必须过鳄鱼潭。

cells.en: “It's the Chocolate Tree!” Dora and Boots find it at last.
cells.cn: “是巧克力树！”Dora 和 Boots 终于找到了它。

cells.en: “Will you help us sing the Chocolate Song?” asks the tree.
cells.cn: 巧克力树问：“你愿意帮我们唱巧克力歌吗？”

cells.en: “It's ready!” The chocolate is for Abuela at home.
cells.cn: “巧克力做好啦！”这份巧克力要带给家里的 Abuela。

S01E19.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Chocolate Tree”.
S01E19.ending: In the end, Dora and Boots bring the chocolate home to Abuela. My favorite part is ______.

S01E20.title: To the Treehouse
S01E20.hook: 树屋要开大派对，Dora 和 Boots 要过鳄鱼湖、翻高墙，路上还帮 Tico、Isa 和 Benny 解决麻烦。

cells.en: Dora and Boots want to get to the big party at the Tree House.
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 想去树屋参加大派对。

cells.en: The Map says, “Lake, Wall, Tree House!” Three places to go.
cells.cn: 地图说：“湖、高墙、树屋！”要去三个地方。

cells.en: Look! Tico brings balloons to the party for everyone.
cells.cn: 看！Tico 给派对带来好多气球。

cells.en: “Now I can sail you across Crocodile Lake,” says the boat.
cells.cn: 小船说：“现在我可以载你们过鳄鱼湖了。”

cells.en: “Will you check my Backpack for a wheel?” asks Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 问：“你能在我的背包里找一个轮子吗？”

cells.en: Benny the bull is stuck in the wall. “We'll help you!”
cells.cn: 公牛 Benny 卡在高墙里。“我们来帮你！”

cells.en: Dora, Boots and Isa pull together. “Pull, pull, pull!”
cells.cn: Dora、Boots 和 Isa 一起用力拉：“拉呀，拉呀，拉！”

cells.en: They reach the Tree House. “Hooray for Dora and Boots!”
cells.cn: 他们到了树屋，大家一起欢呼：“Dora 和 Boots 万岁！”

cells.en: “We had such an exciting trip to the Tree House today.”
cells.cn: “我们今天去树屋的旅程真精彩。”

S01E20.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “To the Treehouse”.
S01E20.ending: In the end, Dora and Boots get to the big party at the Tree House. My favorite part is ______.

S01E21.title: Little Star
S01E21.hook: 一颗小星星从天上掉下来啦！Dora 和 Boots 要过巨魔桥、找到大树和高山，送她回月亮身边。

cells.en: “I make a wish on the first little star I see in the sky.”
cells.cn: “我都会对夜里看到的第一颗小星星许个愿。”

cells.en: “Are you okay, Little Star?” Dora and Boots find her on the ground.
cells.cn: “你还好吗，小星星？”Dora 和 Boots 发现她掉在了地上。

cells.en: They sing “Twinkle, twinkle, little star” to make her feel better.
cells.cn: 他们唱起《一闪一闪小星星》，让小星星开心起来。

cells.en: The Map knows the way to take Little Star home to the moon.
cells.cn: 地图知道怎么把小星星送回月亮身边。

cells.en: How many stars are here tonight? Dora counts them all: “Eleven!”
cells.cn: 今晚天上有几颗星星？Dora 全部数了一遍：“十一颗！”

cells.en: Swiper throws Little Star far away. “You'll never find the star now!”
cells.cn: Swiper 把小星星扔得远远的：“这下你们再也找不到她啦！”

cells.en: Tico climbs up to save Little Star. “Say salta!” says Dora.
cells.cn: Tico 爬上去救小星星。Dora 说：“快说 salta（跳）！”

cells.en: “Moon, moon, I'm coming home!” Little Star is almost at the tall mountain.
cells.cn: “月亮，月亮，我就要回家啦！”小星星快到高山顶了。

cells.en: Look! Little Star is home next to the moon. She is twinkling again.
cells.cn: 看！小星星回到了月亮身边，又眨着眼睛闪闪发亮。

S01E21.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Little Star”.
S01E21.ending: In the end, Little Star goes home to the moon. My favorite part is ______.

S01E22.title: Call Me Mr. Riddles
S01E22.hook: 爱出谜语的猴子 Mr. Riddles 带着 Dora 一路猜谜，去解高山上最大的谜题。

cells.en: Mr. Riddles the monkey hangs from a branch. “I love riddles!” he says.
cells.cn: 猴子 Mr. Riddles 挂在树枝上：“我最爱猜谜语啦！”

cells.en: Dora laughs. “Sure, Boots... I mean Mr. Riddles!” she says.
cells.cn: Dora 笑着说：“当然啦，Boots……我是说，Mr. Riddles！”

cells.en: “So first we need to go over the troll bridge,” Dora says.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“所以我们得先过那座巨魔桥。”

cells.en: “Hmm... what goes hee-haw, hee-haw?” Dora hugs a purple burro.
cells.cn: “嗯……什么东西会嘿嘿、嘿嘿地叫？”Dora 抱着一头紫色小毛驴。

cells.en: They ride the burro. “Let's count all our legs!” says Dora.
cells.cn: 他们骑上小毛驴，Dora 说：“我们来数数一共有几条腿！”

cells.en: A gray cloud rains on them. They hide under a yellow umbrella. “Yay!”
cells.cn: 一朵灰云下起雨来，他们躲到黄伞下面：“太棒了！”

cells.en: The big door has a face. “Knock knock! Orange who?” it asks.
cells.cn: 大大的门长着一张脸，它问：“敲敲门——Orange 谁呀？”

cells.en: The tall mountain has a face. “See, everyone can jump higher,” it says.
cells.cn: 高高的山长着一张脸，它说：“看，每个人都能跳得更高。”

cells.en: “We couldn't have done it without you!” Dora and Mr. Riddles wave.
cells.cn: “没有你我们可做不到！”Dora 和 Mr. Riddles 一起朝你挥手。

S01E22.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Call Me Mr. Riddles”.
S01E22.ending: In the end, Dora and Mr. Riddles solve the silliest riddle at the tall mountain. My favorite part is ______.

S01E23.title: Te Amo
S01E23.hook: 国王 Popo 和王后 Momo 被坏女巫变成了两座山，Dora 要爬上去说一句 Te amo 才能解开魔咒。

cells.en: Every day, King Popo and Queen Momo tell each other “Te amo.”
cells.cn: 每天，Popo 国王和 Momo 王后都会对彼此说：“我爱你。”

cells.en: A mean witch waves her magic wand. “Now they are two big mountains!”
cells.cn: 坏女巫挥动魔杖：“现在他们是两座大山啦！”

cells.en: “Let's stop and think,” says Dora. “We can break the spell!”
cells.cn: Dora 说：“我们停下来想一想——我们能解开这个魔咒！”

cells.en: “Yeah, there's the bridge!” They run down the path to the water.
cells.cn: “对，桥就在那儿！”他们沿着小路向水边跑去。

cells.en: The bridge has a big hole. “Which piece fits here?” asks Boots.
cells.cn: 桥中间有个大洞，Boots 问：“哪一块能拼在这里？”

cells.en: “¡Las rocas!” Dora and Boots ride a purple burro past the rocks.
cells.cn: “岩石！”Dora 和 Boots 骑着紫色小毛驴经过石堆。

cells.en: “Now where are the King Popo and Queen Maria mountains?” Dora asks.
cells.cn: Dora 问：“Popo 国王山和 Maria 王后山现在在哪儿呢？”

cells.en: “We have to climb up the mountains and say ‘Te amo,’” says Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“我们得爬上这两座山，然后说‘我爱你’。”

cells.en: “De nada!” King Popo and Queen Momo hug Dora. Everyone is happy.
cells.cn: “不客气！”Popo 国王和 Momo 王后抱住 Dora，大家都笑了。

S01E23.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Te Amo”.
S01E23.ending: In the end, the king and queen are together again. My favorite part is ______.

S01E24.title: Pablo's Flute
S01E24.hook: 爷爷讲起一支断成三块的旧笛子，Dora 和 Boots 要翻山越岭把碎片找回来。

cells.en: “The second piece had two holes,” says Abuelo. Pablo listens to the story.
cells.cn: “第二块上有两个孔，”爷爷说。Pablo 听着这个故事。

cells.en: “We have to find that flute and give it back to Pablo.”
cells.cn: “我们得找到那支笛子，把它还给 Pablo。”

cells.en: “Bridge, forest, Pablo's Mountain!” Dora reads the way on the map.
cells.cn: “桥、森林、Pablo 的山！”Dora 在地图上看路线。

cells.en: On the bridge Boots says, “Oh, Dora! We have to find the pieces!”
cells.cn: 在桥上 Boots 说：“哎呀 Dora！我们得找到那些碎片！”

cells.en: Three flute pieces lie on the rocks. “Which piece goes next?”
cells.cn: 三块笛子碎片躺在岩石上：“下一块该放哪一块？”

cells.en: “Do you see a forest?” Dora looks at the green trees ahead.
cells.cn: “你看见森林了吗？”Dora 看着前面的绿树。

cells.en: “Look! It's Señor Tucán!” The toucan sits high in the tree.
cells.cn: “看！是巨嘴鸟先生！”它高高地停在树上。

cells.en: “That sounds like Swiper the Fox.” Boots hides behind Dora.
cells.cn: “那声音像是捣蛋鬼 Swiper。”Boots 躲到 Dora 身后。

cells.en: “We found your flute!” Pablo and Abuelo smile at the mountain house.
cells.cn: “我们找到你的笛子了！”Pablo 和爷爷在山顶小屋前笑了。

S01E24.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Pablo's Flute”.
S01E24.ending: In the end, Dora and Boots give the flute back to Pablo. My favorite part is ______.

S01E25.title: Dora Saves the Prince
S01E25.hook: 坏女巫把 Ramón 王子关进高塔，Dora 和 Boots 要过大森林、念魔法词去救他。

cells.en: There was a happy little prince. His name is Prince Ramón.
cells.cn: 从前有一位快乐的小王子，他叫 Ramón 王子。

cells.en: The Mean Witch locks the prince inside. “And the tower door opened.”
cells.cn: 坏女巫把王子关进高塔：“塔门就这样打开了。”

cells.en: “We made it to the gate!” Boots and Dora stand by the blue door.
cells.cn: “我们到大门了！”Boots 和 Dora 站在蓝门前。

cells.en: “Let's use the magic word ‘Abre’ to open the gate.”
cells.cn: “我们用魔法词 Abre 来打开大门吧。”

cells.en: “If you see Swiper the Fox, yell ‘Swiper’!” Dora needs your help.
cells.cn: “如果你看到捣蛋鬼 Swiper，就大声喊‘Swiper’！”Dora 需要你帮忙。

cells.en: Dora looks up inside the tower. “Ooh, there's lots of steps!”
cells.cn: Dora 在高塔里抬头看：“哇，好多台阶呀！”

cells.en: At last they see the High Tower. “Come on, let's get out of here.”
cells.cn: 他们终于看见高塔：“快，我们赶紧上去。”

cells.en: “We need to say the magic word!” The prince holds his magic wand.
cells.cn: “我们要一起说魔法词！”王子举着他的魔法棒。

cells.en: “Friends?” asks the Mean Witch. Now the prince is safe and happy.
cells.cn: “做朋友好吗？”坏女巫问。现在王子又安全又开心。

S01E25.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora Saves the Prince”.
S01E25.ending: In the end, Dora saves the prince and the witch becomes a friend. My favorite part is ______.

S01E26.title: Backpack
S01E26.hook: Dora 得到一个新背包，背包里什么都有。她要过桥、爬大石、去图书馆，一路上背包帮了大忙。

cells.en: “This is a very special Backpack, Dora,” says the big Backpack.
cells.cn: 大背包说：“Dora，这是一个很特别的小背包。”

cells.en: “I'm going to take you with me wherever I go,” says Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“不管我去哪儿，都要带着你。”

cells.en: The Map says, “Bridge, Rock, Library.” That is the way.
cells.cn: 地图说：“桥、大石头、图书馆。”这就是路线。

cells.en: “To cut through the net, use a pair of scissors,” says Backpack.
cells.cn: 背包说：“要剪开网子，就用一把剪刀。”

cells.en: Swiper laughs, “They'll never get it, they'll never get it!”
cells.cn: Swiper 笑着说：“他们永远拿不到，永远拿不到！”

cells.en: “Do you know where I can find a rope?” a friend asks.
cells.cn: 一位朋友问：“你知道我在哪儿能找到绳子吗？”

cells.en: “Will you help us slide down the big rock?” asks Boots.
cells.cn: Boots 问：“你愿意帮我们从大石头上滑下去吗？”

cells.en: At the Library, someone asks, “Do you remember where I put the books?”
cells.cn: 在图书馆里，有人问：“你记得我把书放哪儿了吗？”

cells.en: “Backpack helped us, hooray!” Everyone cheers for the new Backpack.
cells.cn: “背包帮了我们，万岁！”大家一起为新背包欢呼。

S01E26.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Backpack”.
S01E26.ending: In the end, Backpack helps Dora and her friends at the Library. My favorite part is ______.

S02E01.title: Lost Squeaky
S02E01.hook: 洗澡玩具被挤飞，一路追到会喷黏浆的间歇泉。

cells.en: Boots has a new bath toy. He squeezes it and it squeaks!
cells.cn: Boots 有个新洗澡玩具，一捏就“吱吱”叫，他给它取名 Squeaky。

cells.en: Boots squeezes too hard, so Squeaky flies away. Can you help them?
cells.cn: 他挤得太用力，Squeaky 一下飞出双手，一路滚下山坡。

cells.en: Map says Squeaky is going to the Gooey Geyser. They must hurry!
cells.cn: 地图说 Squeaky 正飘向黏糊糊间歇泉，得赶快去追。

cells.en: First they go to Bubble Bridge. Come on, let's get to it!
cells.cn: 三个地方记牢：泡泡桥、泥巴山、间歇泉。先冲向泡泡桥。

cells.en: Big bubbles block the bridge. They pop, pop, pop them all!
cells.cn: 大泡泡把桥堵住了，他们用手指一个个戳破，才走过去。

cells.en: Tico drives them over Muddy Mountain. They shout “¡Para!” to stop!
cells.cn: 下一站泥巴山，Tico 开车载他们，看到泥浆就喊“¡Para!”（停）。

cells.en: The geyser shoots out pink goo. They keep looking for Squeaky.
cells.cn: 间歇泉喷出粉色的黏浆，大家打着伞继续找 Squeaky。

cells.en: Squeaky bounces out of the goo. Everyone shouts, “Squeeze him!”
cells.cn: Squeaky 从黏浆里蹦了出来，大家一起喊“快捏捏他”，把它接住。

cells.en: Boots is happy again. What a lucky day for little Squeaky!
cells.cn: Squeaky 回来了，Boots 又开心起来，大家一起欢呼。

S02E01.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Lost Squeaky”.
S02E01.ending: In the end, Boots gets Squeaky back. My favorite part is ______.

S02E02.title: The Missing Piece
S02E02.hook: 拼图少了一块，那块是巫师的魔法棒，藏在彩虹尽头。

cells.en: Dora and Boots put the puzzle together, piece by piece. It is a wizard!
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 一块一块拼拼图，拼出来的是一位巫师。

cells.en: Oh no! The wizard's magic wand is missing. He cannot do magic!
cells.cn: 糟糕，巫师 El Encantador 少了魔法棒那一块，变不了魔术了。

cells.en: Map says the wand is at the end of the rainbow, far away.
cells.cn: 地图说魔法棒在彩虹的尽头，得先过鳄鱼湖、再穿红隧道。
cells.key: end of the rainbow · far away

cells.en: Here is Crocodile Lake. Benny's boat has no oars at all!
cells.cn: 到了鳄鱼湖，Benny 的小船连船桨都没有，根本划不动。

cells.en: They row across the lake fast. Crocodiles swim after the boat!
cells.cn: 他们用力划船穿过湖面，一群鳄鱼在后面追着船游。

cells.en: Tico's yellow car cannot go. One of its tires is missing!
cells.cn: Tico 的黄车走不了，原来少了一个轮胎，装上才能开。

cells.en: They come out of the red tunnel. A big rainbow is right there!
cells.cn: 穿过红隧道，一道大彩虹就在眼前，彩虹尽头快到了。

cells.en: “Oh, my wand, my wand!” The wizard finds it at last!
cells.cn: “我的魔法棒，我的魔法棒！”巫师终于在彩虹尽头找到了它。

cells.en: Everyone cheers under the rainbow. The wizard can do magic again!
cells.cn: 大家在彩虹下欢呼，巫师又能变魔术了，拼图也完整了。

S02E02.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Missing Piece”.
S02E02.ending: In the end, the wizard gets his magic wand back. My favorite part is ______.

S02E03.title: The Big Storm
S02E03.hook: 雨云一路追着他们跑，唱首歌真的能把雨赶走吗？

cells.en: Dora looks up at the clouds. A big storm is coming soon!
cells.cn: Dora 抬头看云，乌云越聚越多，一场大暴风雨要来了。

cells.en: Map shows the quick way home before the big storm comes.
cells.cn: 地图指了一条最快的回家路，要赶在暴风雨前面到家。

cells.en: First the bush, then the forest, then Dora's house!
cells.cn: 先穿过灌木丛，再穿过森林，最后就到 Dora 的家。

cells.en: They sing, “Rain, rain, go away. Come again some other day!”
cells.cn: 他们一起唱《雨啊雨啊快走开》，想把雨云赶跑。

cells.en: The wind breaks Benny's tree house. They need pieces of wood.
cells.cn: 大风吹坏了 Benny 的树屋，得先找木片才能修。

cells.en: Here is a red triangle. It can be the roof of the house!
cells.cn: 找到一块红色的三角形木片，正好可以当屋顶。

cells.en: Tico must take the blue path. They shout “Azul!” to help him.
cells.cn: Tico 得走蓝色那条路，大家喊“Azul”（蓝色）给他指路。

cells.en: The tree house is fixed and the rain stops. Everyone shouts, “Yay!”
cells.cn: 树屋修好了，雨也停了，大家高兴地欢呼起来。

cells.en: A big rainbow comes out. They stopped the storm together!
cells.cn: 天边出现一道大彩虹——他们真的把暴风雨赶走了。

S02E03.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Big Storm”.
S02E03.ending: In the end, they fix the tree house and the rain stops. My favorite part is ______.

S02E04.title: The Magic Stick
S02E04.hook: 从土里拔出一根小棍，它到底能做什么？答案在最高的山顶。

cells.en: Boots pulls a little stick out of the ground. Is it magic?
cells.cn: Boots 从土里拔出一根小棍子，它会不会是一根魔法棒？

cells.en: Map says they must cross the river and go over the wall.
cells.cn: 地图说路线：先过河，再翻过一堵高墙，才能到山顶。

cells.en: They walk and walk. Where are they going with the stick?
cells.cn: 他们一路走一路问“我们要去哪儿”，跟着地图往前走。

cells.en: To cross the river, they ask Backpack for a paddle.
cells.cn: 要过河，他们喊来 Backpack，从背包里找出一支船桨。

cells.en: Snakes are in the grass. They walk away from them slowly.
cells.cn: 草丛里藏着蛇，他们慢慢绕开，小心别踩到。

cells.en: A toucan calls “Gordo!” A long stick lies on the ground.
cells.cn: 大嘴鸟喊了一声“Gordo”，地上正好躺着一根长长的树枝。

cells.en: They count one, two, three and climb the tall ladder.
cells.cn: 他们一边数一二三，一边爬上高高的梯子，翻过墙。

cells.en: On the top of the hill, they put the stick in the ground.
cells.cn: 到了最高的山顶，他们把魔法棒插进土里，等它施展魔力。

cells.en: Flowers bloom everywhere! “You brought our hill back to life!”
cells.cn: 满山的花一下子全开了，青蛙说“你让我们的山活了过来！”

S02E04.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Magic Stick”.
S02E04.ending: In the end, the stick brings flowers to the hill. My favorite part is ______.

S02E05.title: Rojo, the Fire Truck
S02E05.hook: 新消防车第一次出任务，小猫困在树上，云梯够得着吗？

cells.en: Dora and Boots go to the station to meet the newest fire truck.
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 跑到消防站，去认识新来的消防车。

cells.en: Rojo says, “You can be my firefighters!” They put on helmets.
cells.cn: 消防车 Rojo 说“你们可以当我的消防员”，两人戴上黄头盔。

cells.en: Map shows the road. A kitten is stuck high in a tree!
cells.cn: 地图指出路线：有只小猫困在一棵很高的大树上。

cells.en: They drive down the road fast. “Go, Rojo, go!”
cells.cn: 消防车沿着大路飞快地开，大家一起喊“Rojo，快跑！”

cells.en: Rojo needs to start. They count from one up to ten.
cells.cn: 消防车要发动了，大家一起从一数到十给它加油。

cells.en: Which button sounds the siren? The blue one, of course!
cells.cn: 该按哪个按钮才会响警笛？当然是蓝色的那一个！

cells.en: They stop at the big tree. The kitten is still up there.
cells.cn: 他们停在大树下面，小猫还高高地待在树枝上。

cells.en: Rojo lifts the ladder high. Dora climbs up to the kitten.
cells.cn: Rojo 把云梯升得高高的，Dora 爬上去抱住了小猫。

cells.en: The kitten is safe. Everyone says, “Thank you for the rescue!”
cells.cn: 小猫得救了，大家一起说“谢谢你来救我们！”

S02E05.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Rojo, the Fire Truck”.
S02E05.ending: In the end, Rojo saves the kitten in the tree. My favorite part is ______.

S02E06.title: El Día de las Madres
S02E06.hook: 十根香蕉、六颗坚果、一块巧克力，一样都不能少。

cells.en: Mami wants to make a surprise cake for Mother's Day today.
cells.cn: 母亲节到了，Mami 想烤一个特别的蛋糕给大家一个惊喜。

cells.en: Ten bananas, six nuts, and one piece of chocolate. That is all!
cells.cn: 材料清单：十根香蕉、六颗坚果、一块巧克力，齐了就能开烤。

cells.en: Map shows the way to the bananas, the nuts, and home.
cells.cn: 地图指了路：先找香蕉，再找坚果，最后回家。

cells.en: At the banana tree, they count one, two, three, up to ten.
cells.cn: 到了香蕉树，他们一根一根地数，一直数到十根。

cells.en: They look here and there in the forest for little nuts.
cells.cn: 他们在树林里东找西找，寻找一颗颗小小的坚果。

cells.en: They count six nuts and put them all in the basket.
cells.cn: 他们数出六颗坚果，全部放进小篮子里。

cells.en: Boots picks white flowers for Mami. What a sweet gift!
cells.cn: Boots 摘了一把白色的小花，这是给妈妈的另一份礼物。

cells.en: All the mommies come to the party. Isa brings her mommy too.
cells.cn: 妈妈们都来参加派对，Isa 也把自己的妈妈带来了。

cells.en: The cake is ready. Everyone shouts, “Happy Mother's Day!”
cells.cn: 蛋糕烤好了，大家一齐喊“母亲节快乐！”

S02E06.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “El Día de las Madres”.
S02E06.ending: In the end, they make a cake for Mami. My favorite part is ______.

S02E07.title: The Golden Explorers
S02E07.hook: 和恐龙踢一场足球，球门到底藏在哪儿？

cells.en: Dora and her friends meet some dinosaurs. They all want to play soccer!
cells.cn: Dora 和朋友们遇到一群恐龙，大家约好来踢一场足球赛。

cells.en: They must kick the ball into the net to score a goal.
cells.cn: 要把球踢进球门才能得分，可球门在很远的地方。

cells.en: Map shows the way to the net. They must pass a tall tree.
cells.cn: 地图指路：去球门要先经过一棵很高的大树。

cells.en: They say it together: “Tree, tall, net!” to remember the way.
cells.cn: 他们一起念口诀“树、高高的、球门”，生怕把路忘了。

cells.en: Where is the little dinosaur? He hides behind the trees.
cells.cn: 小恐龙躲到树林里去了，大家一起找他藏在哪儿。

cells.en: They walk on and on with the ball. Where is the net?
cells.cn: 他们带着球一直往前走，球门到底还有多远？

cells.en: One big dinosaur sits right in the middle of the field.
cells.cn: 一只大恐龙坐在球场正中间，把前面的路挡得死死的。

cells.en: Do you see the net? Look carefully. They are almost there!
cells.cn: 你看见球门了吗？仔细找一找，就快到了。

cells.en: “¡Lo Hicimos!” They score a goal and win the whole game!
cells.cn: “我们做到了！”他们踢进一球，赢下了整场比赛。

S02E07.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Golden Explorers”.
S02E07.ending: In the end, their team scores a goal. My favorite part is ______.

S02E08.title: Doctor Dora
S02E08.hook: Benny 一直打喷嚏，到底是什么让他过敏？

cells.en: Dora is a doctor today. She checks her friends one by one.
cells.cn: 今天 Dora 当小医生，一个一个给朋友们检查身体。

cells.en: Map says the way is the mole hill, the red rock, then the barn.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过地鼠山，再经过红石，最后到谷仓。

cells.en: Benny keeps sneezing. They must find out what makes him sneeze!
cells.cn: Benny 一直打喷嚏，他们得找出到底是什么让他过敏。

cells.en: “Come on, ¡vamonos!” They walk to the barn to help Benny.
cells.cn: “走吧！”他们出发去谷仓，要帮 Benny 治好过敏。

cells.en: First they help the Big Red Chicken. His foot is stuck!
cells.cn: 路上先帮大红鸟，它的一只脚被卡住动不了了。

cells.en: They meet Azul, the blue train, and he gives them a ride.
cells.cn: 他们遇到蓝色小火车 Azul，它载着大家继续往前走。

cells.en: Backpack has a lollipop and a sticker for poor Benny.
cells.cn: 他们说“Backpack”，从背包里拿出棒棒糖和贴纸送给 Benny。

cells.en: At the barn, a feather pillow makes Benny sneeze again!
cells.cn: 到了谷仓，原来是羽毛枕头让 Benny 又打起了喷嚏。

cells.en: They take the pillow away. Benny feels much better now!
cells.cn: 把羽毛枕头拿走，Benny 立刻舒服多了，大家都笑了。

S02E08.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Doctor Dora”.
S02E08.ending: In the end, Benny stops sneezing. My favorite part is ______.

S02E09.title: Pinto, the Pony Express
S02E09.hook: 牛仔要送一袋饼干，可路上还有 Swiper 在等着。

cells.en: Cowgirl Dora and Cowboy Boots ride Pinto the pony. Yee-ha!
cells.cn: 牛仔 Dora 和牛仔 Boots 骑上小马 Pinto，喊着“Yee-ha”出发。

cells.en: Map says: the cactus tunnel, the rocks, then Benny's barn.
cells.cn: 地图指路：仙人掌隧道 → 岩石 → Benny 的谷仓。

cells.en: They say it again and again so they will not forget.
cells.cn: 他们一遍又一遍念着这三个地方，怕走错了路。

cells.en: “Is that just a cactus?” They ride across the hot desert.
cells.cn: “那只是一棵仙人掌吗？”他们骑着马穿过炎热的沙漠。

cells.en: In the dark tunnel, they follow seven little gold stones.
cells.cn: 走进黑黑的仙人掌隧道，他们跟着七颗小石头往前走。

cells.en: “Sounds like a snake!” They ride on very carefully.
cells.cn: “好像有蛇！”他们放慢速度，小心地往前骑。

cells.en: At last they see the red barn. Benny is waiting inside!
cells.cn: 终于看见红色的谷仓，Benny 正在里面等着收饼干。

cells.en: Uh-oh, here comes Swiper! They must keep the cookies safe.
cells.cn: 糟糕，Swiper 出现了！他们得把饼干藏好，不能让它偷走。

cells.en: The cookies are safe. Everyone eats them up. Yum, yum!
cells.cn: 饼干保住了，大家一起吃得津津有味，Yum yum！

S02E09.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Pinto, the Pony Express”.
S02E09.ending: In the end, Benny gets his cookies. My favorite part is ______.

S02E10.title: The Big Piñata
S02E10.hook: 十张黄票才能换到那个大皮纳塔，还差几张？

cells.en: Dora and Boots come to the carnival. There is so much to do!
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 来到嘉年华，这里好玩的东西太多了。

cells.en: Map says: past the ferris wheel, then the merry-go-round, then the piñata.
cells.cn: 地图指路：经过摩天轮 → 旋转木马 → 大皮纳塔。

cells.en: To win the big piñata, they must get ten yellow tickets.
cells.cn: 想赢到那个大皮纳塔，得先集满十张黄色奖券。

cells.en: They play a game, but one piece is missing. Where is it?
cells.cn: 他们玩一个拼图游戏，可少了一块，得把它找出来。

cells.en: “Come on, let's go win the big piñata!” They run on.
cells.cn: “走，去把大皮纳塔赢回来！”他们又跑着往前赶。

cells.en: Look out! Is that Swiper by the shop? They hurry away.
cells.cn: 小心！商店旁边那个是 Swiper 吗？他们赶紧跑开。

cells.en: They ride the merry-go-round and win more yellow tickets.
cells.cn: 他们坐上旋转木马，又赢到了几张黄票。

cells.en: “We have ten yellow tickets!” Now they can get the piñata.
cells.cn: “我们有十张黄票啦！”这下终于可以换大皮纳塔了。

cells.en: The piñata breaks open. Toys and candy fall out for everyone!
cells.cn: 皮纳塔被打开，玩具和糖果撒了一地，人人都有份。

S02E10.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Big Piñata”.
S02E10.ending: In the end, they win the big piñata. My favorite part is ______.

S02E11.title: The Happy Old Troll
S02E11.hook: 什么东西都哄不好的巨魔，其实只要三样东西。

cells.en: The old troll sits by his bridge. Nothing makes him smile today.
cells.cn: 老巨魔坐在桥边，一脸不高兴，什么都提不起他的兴趣。

cells.en: Only three things make him happy. Map shows where they are.
cells.cn: 只有三样东西能让他开心，地图指出了它们在哪里。

cells.en: First they go to the red bush to look for a flower.
cells.cn: 第一站是红色的灌木，他们要在那儿找一朵花。

cells.en: Swiper comes along! They must stop him and keep going.
cells.cn: Swiper 突然冒出来捣蛋，他们把他赶走才继续赶路。

cells.en: At last they find a purple flower for the old troll.
cells.cn: 他们终于找到一朵紫色的小花，这是巨魔最喜欢的第一样东西。

cells.en: The Big Red Chicken helps them get across the river. ¡Vamos!
cells.cn: 大红鸟驮着他们过了大河，大家一起喊“¡Vamos!”。

cells.en: They say “Backpack” and find what they need inside.
cells.cn: 他们一喊“Backpack”，背包里就跳出需要的东西。

cells.en: They ride a big balloon up high to find the flying horses.
cells.cn: 他们坐上彩色热气球往高处升，去找会飞的小马。

cells.en: The troll has all three things. He jumps up and dances!
cells.cn: 三样东西都齐了，老巨魔高兴得跳起来，跳了一支开心舞。

S02E11.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Happy Old Troll”.
S02E11.ending: In the end, the troll dances a happy dance. My favorite part is ______.

S02E12.title: A Letter for Swiper
S02E12.hook: 邮差鸟看不清路，四封信要送到四个朋友手里。

cells.en: The mail bird breaks her glasses. She cannot see the way!
cells.cn: 邮差鸟把眼镜摔坏了，看不清路，信送不出去了。

cells.en: Map says: the forest, the barn, then Blueberry Hill.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过森林，再到农场，最后上蓝莓山。

cells.en: “Delivering letters is a hard job,” says Boots on the way.
cells.cn: 路上 Boots 说：“送信可真是个辛苦活儿。”

cells.en: There are four letters: for Swiper, Isa, Tico and Benny.
cells.cn: 一共四封信，收信人是 Swiper、Isa、Tico 和 Benny。

cells.en: They walk to the barn and give Benny his letter first.
cells.cn: 他们先走到农场，把第一封信交到 Benny 手里。

cells.en: Snow starts to fall. They say “Backpack” and get warm things.
cells.cn: 天上飘起雪花，他们喊“Backpack”，从背包里拿出保暖的东西。

cells.en: Two letters are still in their hands. They must keep going.
cells.cn: 手里还剩两封信，他们得顶住风雪继续往前走。

cells.en: They march up Blueberry Hill as fast as they can.
cells.cn: 他们用最快的速度，一步一步爬上蓝莓山。

cells.en: At last they give Swiper his letter. His grandma sent it!
cells.cn: 最后他们终于把信交给了 Swiper——原来是奶奶寄来的。

S02E12.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “A Letter for Swiper”.
S02E12.ending: In the end, Swiper gets a letter from his grandma. My favorite part is ______.

S02E13.title: Click
S02E13.hook: 想赢摄影比赛，得先拍到那些躲起来的动物。

cells.en: Look at all these animal photos on the wall. How nice!
cells.cn: 墙上挂满了动物的照片，一张比一张好看。

cells.en: Map says: the rain forest, the tallest mountain, then Blueberry Hill.
cells.cn: 地图指路：雨林 → 最高的山 → 蓝莓山。
cells.key: rain forest · tallest mountain · Blueberry Hill

cells.en: Dora holds her camera. “Let's look for animals!” Click, click!
cells.cn: Dora 举起相机：“我们去找动物吧！”咔嚓，咔嚓。

cells.en: They walk into the green rain forest. What can they see?
cells.cn: 他们走进绿油油的雨林，这里会藏着什么动物呢？

cells.en: A blue sloth hangs in the tree. “Say buenos días!” Click!
cells.cn: 一只蓝色树懒挂在树上，他们说“Buenos días”（早上好）再拍照。

cells.en: There it is, the tallest mountain. It looks like a big cone.
cells.cn: 最高的山到了，尖尖的像一个大圆锥，真高啊。

cells.en: Next comes Blueberry Hill. They are nearly at the end!
cells.cn: 下一站就是蓝莓山，他们的拍摄之旅快完成了。

cells.en: “Backpack!” They need a camera and a battery inside.
cells.cn: 他们喊“Backpack”，从背包里拿出相机和电池。

cells.en: All their photos are on the wall now. What a great day!
cells.cn: 他们拍的照片全都挂上了墙，这一天真没白忙。

S02E13.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Click”.
S02E13.ending: In the end, their animal photos go on the wall. My favorite part is ______.

S02E14.title: ¡Rápido, Tico!
S02E14.hook: 包裹是空的，玩具消防车跑到雪山山顶去了。

cells.en: Boots opens the box. It is empty! Where is his fire truck?
cells.cn: Boots 打开包裹，里面空空的——他的消防车玩具不见了。

cells.en: Map says: the hill, the big slide, then Snowy Mountain.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过长满草的山丘，再走大滑梯，最后到雪山。

cells.en: Tico drives up in his yellow car. “Hop in, amigos!”
cells.cn: Tico 开着黄色小车赶来：“朋友们，快上车！”

cells.en: Something blocks the road. “¡Para!” Tico stops the car.
cells.cn: 前面有东西挡住路，他们喊“¡Para!”（停），Tico 赶紧刹车。

cells.en: They say “Backpack” to get the things they need for the trip.
cells.cn: 他们喊“Backpack”，把路上要用到的东西从背包里取出来。

cells.en: They must cross the water. But that Swiper is pretty tricky!
cells.cn: 他们要过湖，可那只 Swiper 总是花样百出地来捣乱。

cells.en: Hill, slide, snowy mountain. They say it again to remember.
cells.cn: 山丘、滑梯、雪山，他们再念一遍，怕走错方向。

cells.en: They pedal hard in the little flying machine. Up they go!
cells.cn: 他们用力踩着那台小飞行器，一点点往山顶升上去。

cells.en: There it is, the red fire truck, right on top of the snow!
cells.cn: 找到了！红色的玩具消防车就停在雪山顶上。

S02E14.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “¡Rápido, Tico!”.
S02E14.ending: In the end, Boots finds his toy fire truck. My favorite part is ______.

S02E15.title: A Present For Santa
S02E15.hook: 平安夜，多出来一份礼物——是给圣诞老人的，可圣诞老人住在北极。

cells.en: It is Christmas Eve. Dora is at Abuela's house. She has a present for Boots.
cells.cn: 平安夜，Dora 在奶奶家，树下的礼物堆得像小山，她给 Boots 准备了一份。

cells.en: There is one more present. It is for Santa! But Santa lives at the North Pole.
cells.cn: 还剩一份礼物，是送给圣诞老人的！可圣诞老人住在遥远的北极。

cells.en: Map says: “Mountains, river, North Pole!” First they must cross the mountains.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过雪山，再过河，最后到北极。

cells.en: A little blue train comes. “We're going to the North Pole!” says Dora.
cells.cn: 蓝色小火车开过来，Dora 抱着礼物说：“我们要去北极啦！”

cells.en: The train goes through the snow. The present is shaped like a rectangle.
cells.cn: 小火车穿过雪地，礼物盒是长方形的，抱在怀里稳稳的。

cells.en: On the mountain they meet a big snow cat. It is white and very funny.
cells.cn: 雪山上他们遇到一只大雪猫，白白的，样子特别逗。

cells.t: Do You See the North Pole?
cells.en: They walk and walk. “Do you see the North Pole?” “Yes! Over there!”
cells.cn: 他们走啊走，互相问：“你看到北极了没有？”——“看到了，就在那边！”

cells.en: Santa opens the present. It is a guitar! He plays it and sings “¡Feliz Navidad!”
cells.cn: 圣诞老人打开礼物——是一把吉他！他弹起来，唱着“圣诞快乐”。

cells.en: Santa and the elves say thank you. Everyone is happy on Christmas Eve.
cells.cn: 圣诞老人和小精灵一起道谢，平安夜的雪地里全是笑声。

S02E15.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “A Present For Santa”.
S02E15.ending: In the end, Santa gets the guitar and plays it. My favorite part is ______.

S02E16.title: Super Map!
S02E16.hook: 天上掉下一件红斗篷，地图一下子变成了会飞的“超级地图”。

cells.en: Something red flies down from the sky. It is a red cape — for Map!
cells.cn: 天上飞下来一件红红的东西——是一件红斗篷，正好给地图用。

cells.en: Now Map is Super Map! He can fly and use his super breath.
cells.cn: 地图从此变成“超级地图”，会飞，还会吹出超级大风。

cells.en: Super Map uses his super breath to blow the clouds away.
cells.cn: 超级地图用他的超级吹气把乌云都吹散了。

cells.en: In the jungle they say hello to the baby birds. “Chipi, chipi!”
cells.cn: 丛林里有一群小鸟，他们挥手打招呼：“chipi，chipi！”

cells.en: Oh no! There are lots of snakes and spiders on this path.
cells.cn: 糟糕，这条路上到处都是蛇和蜘蛛，不能走。

cells.en: They have to super-jump across the logs. One, two, three — jump!
cells.cn: 他们只能“超级跳”，一根一根木头跳过去。

cells.en: They row a little red boat down the river. Super Map flies above them.
cells.cn: 他们坐上小红船顺流而下，超级地图在头顶飞着带路。

cells.en: At Dora's house there is a super duper slide. Down they go — whee!
cells.cn: 家门口有个超大的滑梯，他们一路滑下来，开心极了。

cells.en: Mami and Papi are waiting. “We did it!” everyone shouts.
cells.cn: 妈妈和爸爸在院子里等着，大家一起喊“我们做到了！”

S02E16.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Super Map!”.
S02E16.ending: In the end, Super Map helps them get home. My favorite part is ______.

S02E17.title: Lost Map
S02E17.hook: 傻大鸟把地图叼去当鸟窝的树枝，Dora 只好自己画一张地图。

cells.en: A big silly bird takes Map away. “Come back, bird!” shouts Dora.
cells.cn: 一只傻乎乎的大鸟把地图叼走了，Dora 边追边喊：“回来，大鸟！”

cells.en: “How can we find Map?” “I know! I will draw a map!”
cells.cn: 没有地图怎么找路？Dora 说：“我知道！我自己画一张！”

cells.en: First they come to the butterfly garden. There are flowers everywhere.
cells.cn: 第一站是蝴蝶花园，一眼望去全是盛开的花。

cells.en: Next is the cornfield. “Whoa! That corn is really high!”
cells.cn: 第二站是玉米地，“哇，这些玉米长得真高！”

cells.en: Three paths go through the corn. “What's the third color?” Blue!
cells.cn: 玉米地里有三条彩色小路，第三条是蓝色的，走这条！

cells.en: “Right!” Now they can see the Tallest Mountain far away.
cells.cn: “对，往右！”抬头就能看见远处最高的那座山。

cells.en: Watermelons roll down the hill! They must jump over them, one by one.
cells.cn: 西瓜骨碌碌从坡上滚下来，他们只能一个一个跳过去。

cells.en: At the top, the silly bird used Map as a stick for its nest.
cells.cn: 爬上山顶才看清：那只傻鸟把地图当成树枝，插在鸟窝里。

cells.en: Dora's own map works! “You went to the butterfly garden…”
cells.cn: Dora 亲手画的地图真的管用，一路把他们带到了山顶。

S02E17.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Lost Map”.
S02E17.ending: In the end, they find Map in the bird's nest. My favorite part is ______.

S02E18.title: Dora, La Música
S02E18.hook: 游行就要开始了，音乐盒却打不开——只有演奏音乐才能打开它。

cells.en: It is the day of the big parade. But Señor Shush shouts, “I want quiet!”
cells.cn: 今天村里要游行，大家抱着乐器又唱又跳，可“嘘先生”大喊：“我要安静！”

cells.en: Map says: the piano bridge, the singing gate, then the music box.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过钢琴桥，再过会唱歌的大门，最后到音乐盒。

cells.en: Benny the Bull needs an instrument too. “Backpack!” Dora calls.
cells.cn: 小牛 Benny 也想参加，可是他没有乐器，Dora 只好向背包求助。

cells.en: Uh-oh! The bridge is missing some pieces. “We have to cross the bridge, but…”
cells.cn: 糟糕！钢琴桥缺了好几块琴键，想过桥却没有路。

cells.en: They tell Señor Tucán “larga” for a long piece and “corta” for a short one.
cells.cn: 他们对巨嘴鸟先生喊“larga”（长）和“corta”（短），让他叼来合适的琴键。

cells.en: Next is the singing gate. “Hi, Singing Gate!” They must sing to go through.
cells.cn: 接下来是会唱歌的大门，得先唱一首歌，门才肯打开。

cells.en: They play their instruments and the music box opens. “We opened the music box!”
cells.cn: 大家一起演奏，音乐盒终于打开了，游行可以开始了。

cells.en: “Señor Shush, would you like to join our parranda?” He says yes!
cells.cn: Dora 邀请嘘先生一起加入游行，他居然点头答应了。

cells.en: “Go ahead, try the cymbals.” Now Señor Shush makes music too!
cells.cn: “来，试试这对铜钹。”嘘先生也成了乐队的一员。

S02E18.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora, La Música”.
S02E18.ending: In the end, the music box opens and everyone plays music. My favorite part is ______.

S02E19.title: Egg Hunt
S02E19.hook: 找彩蛋啦！篮子里要凑满十二个蛋，最大的奖品藏在大金蛋里。

cells.en: Dora and Boots are going on an egg hunt. There are prizes inside the eggs!
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 去参加找彩蛋活动，每个彩蛋里都藏着奖品。

cells.en: Map says: the river, the big yellow egg, then Grandma's house.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先到河边，再找大金蛋，最后去奶奶家。

cells.en: “Come on! Let's go find all the eggs!” They carry a big basket.
cells.cn: “走吧，把所有彩蛋都找出来！”他们拎着一个大篮子出发。

cells.en: A white bunny shows them where to look. Thank you, bunny!
cells.cn: 一只白兔蹦出来给他们带路，谢谢小兔子！

cells.en: “An egg!” Dora finds one hiding in the yellow flowers.
cells.cn: “找到一个！”Dora 在黄花丛里摸出一个彩蛋。

cells.en: At the farm they ask: which animal says “moo, moo”? The cow!
cells.cn: 到了农场，他们要猜：哪种动物“哞哞”叫？——是奶牛！

cells.en: Three orange cats sit on the hay. And look — an egg is there too!
cells.cn: 干草堆上坐着三只橘猫，它们身下还藏着一个彩蛋。

cells.en: They find all twelve eggs. The basket is full of colours!
cells.cn: 十二个彩蛋全找到了，篮子里花花绿绿，装得满满的。

cells.en: At Grandma's house they open the big yellow egg. Confetti everywhere!
cells.cn: 在奶奶家门口敲开大金蛋，彩纸撒了满天。

S02E19.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Egg Hunt”.
S02E19.ending: In the end, they open the big yellow egg at Grandma's house. My favorite part is ______.

S02E20.title: To The Monkey Bars
S02E20.hook: Dora 一直有个小秘密：她从来没爬完过那排猴架。

cells.en: Dora reads her photo album to the little kids. “And I'm Boots.”
cells.cn: Dora 翻开相册，一页一页讲给小朋友听。

cells.en: Dora has a secret: the monkey bars. “I've tried and I've tried.”
cells.cn: Dora 说出一个小秘密——那排猴架，她试了好多次都没爬完。

cells.en: Map says: the troll's bridge, the windy hill, then the play park.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过巨魔桥，再翻风山，最后到游乐场。

cells.en: A grumpy troll lives under the bridge. He sings a song and lets them pass.
cells.cn: 桥下住着一个怪脾气的巨魔，他唱完一首歌才肯放行。

cells.en: On the windy hill it is cold. Backpack gives them warm coats and hats.
cells.cn: 风山上很冷，背包里掏出厚外套和帽子，还拉好了拉链。

cells.en: They stomp their feet and climb. “I'll give you a ride down!”
cells.cn: 他们跺着脚往上爬，风笑着说：“那我送你们滑下去吧！”

cells.en: There he is — Tico is on the swings at the play park!
cells.cn: 游乐场到了，Tico 正在秋千上荡得高高的。

cells.en: “Will you help me climb all the way across all ten monkey bars?”
cells.cn: “你们能帮我一起数，爬完这十根猴架吗？”

cells.en: “We made it! All the way across the monkey bars!”
cells.cn: “我们做到了！一口气爬过整排猴架！”

S02E20.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “To The Monkey Bars”.
S02E20.ending: In the end, Dora climbs across all ten monkey bars. My favorite part is ______.

S02E21.title: Hide And Go Seek
S02E21.hook: 玩捉迷藏啦！把八个朋友全找到，就能赢得金色大奖杯。

cells.en: Everybody wants to play hide and go seek. “Find all our friends and we win the big trophy!”
cells.cn: 大家一起来玩捉迷藏：把朋友全都找到，就能赢走金色大奖杯。

cells.en: Eight friends are super-good at hiding. Can you count them?
cells.cn: 八个好朋友都特别会藏，你能一个不少地数出来吗？

cells.en: Map shows the way: the big tree, then the squirrel trees.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先到大树，再去松鼠树。

cells.en: “¡Me encontraron!” Someone is found hiding under a big purple blanket.
cells.cn: “我被找到啦！”藏在紫色大布下面的伙伴被发现了。

cells.en: At the cave, Swiper comes. “Swiper, no swiping!” He runs away.
cells.cn: 山洞前 Swiper 又来了，“Swiper，不许抢！”他只好溜走。

cells.en: The squirrel trees are busy. Squirrels paint, water plants and read.
cells.cn: 松鼠树上热闹极了，松鼠们画画、浇花、看书。

cells.en: “Did we find everybody?” “Yes! Everybody is here!”
cells.cn: “所有人都找到了吗？”——“找齐啦，一个都不少！”

cells.en: Señor Tucán gives them a ride home in the red cable car.
cells.cn: 巨嘴鸟先生让他们坐上红色缆车，一路送回家。

cells.en: Dora holds up the big gold trophy. “¡Ganaste el trofeo!”
cells.cn: Dora 举起金色大奖杯——捉迷藏冠军是他们！

S02E21.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Hide And Go Seek”.
S02E21.ending: In the end, they find everybody and win the big trophy. My favorite part is ______.

S02E22.title: School Pet
S02E22.hook: 带宠物上学的日子，班里的小仓鼠 Mimo 却不见了。

cells.en: It is show-and-tell day. But oh no — Mimo is missing!
cells.cn: 今天是“带宠物上学”的日子，可糟糕——小仓鼠 Mimo 不见了！

cells.en: Map says: cross the bridge, go through the jungle, then the pyramids!
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过桥，再穿过丛林，最后到金字塔。

cells.en: The bridge is missing some boards. They must step on the planks.
cells.cn: 桥板缺了好几块，只能踩着一块块木板跳过去。

cells.en: “Oops! That's a crocodile!” The planks are on its back!
cells.cn: “糟了，那是鳄鱼！”原来木板就搭在鳄鱼背上。

cells.en: They call Backpack for more planks, then cross the bridge safely.
cells.cn: 他们喊来背包，多拿几块木板，稳稳当当过了桥。

cells.en: In the jungle they swing on vines. “The blue one or the red one?”
cells.cn: 丛林里他们抓着藤蔓荡过去：“选蓝色的还是红色的？”

cells.en: Three pyramids, three stars: blue, yellow and rainbow. Which one?
cells.cn: 三座金字塔，三颗星——蓝星、黄星、彩虹星，走哪一座？

cells.en: There is Mimo, peeking out of a little door in the pyramid!
cells.cn: 找到了！Mimo 正从金字塔的小门里探出头来。

cells.en: Mimo is back in its cage. “Yay!” Everybody is happy again.
cells.cn: Mimo 回到笼子里了，全班一起欢呼，教室又热闹起来。

S02E22.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “School Pet”.
S02E22.ending: In the end, they bring Mimo back to its cage. My favorite part is ______.

S02E23.title: Quack! Quack!
S02E23.hook: 涂色本里的小黄鸭跳出来了，得把它送回鸭妈妈身边。

cells.en: Dora colours a duck pond for Mommy Duck. Five eggs wait in the grass.
cells.cn: Dora 在涂色本上给鸭妈妈画一个池塘，草里还等着五个白白的蛋。

cells.en: A little yellow duckling jumps out of the book! “Quack, quack!”
cells.cn: 一只小黄鸭从书里跳了出来：“嘎嘎，嘎嘎！”

cells.en: Map says: the rainbow, then the duck pond. “We'll bring your baby home soon.”
cells.cn: 地图指路：先上彩虹桥，再到鸭子池塘——“我们很快把宝宝送回家。”

cells.en: The duckling wants colours. “Colour it red!” Then green, then blue.
cells.cn: 小鸭子喜欢颜色，他们把画涂成红的、绿的、蓝的。

cells.en: At the market there are so many colours and shapes. Which do they need?
cells.cn: 市场上有好多颜色和形状，他们该拿哪一个呢？

cells.en: They take paint and brushes to finish the picture for the duckling.
cells.cn: 他们带上颜料和刷子，把画一点点补完整。

cells.en: “Look! There's a rainbow!” It makes a bridge for them to cross.
cells.cn: “快看，是彩虹！”彩虹变成了一座桥，让他们走过去。

cells.en: “Do you see Mommy Duck?” “Yes! She's by the pond!”
cells.cn: “你看见鸭妈妈了吗？”——“看见了，就在池塘边上！”

cells.en: “¡Gracias por su ayuda!” Mommy Duck has all her ducklings again.
cells.cn: “谢谢你们帮忙！”鸭妈妈又和它的宝宝们团聚了。

S02E23.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Quack! Quack!”.
S02E23.ending: In the end, the duckling finds Mommy Duck at the pond. My favorite part is ______.

S02E24.title: León, The Circus Lion
S02E24.hook: 狮子 León 想进马戏团当演员，可他有点儿不敢。

cells.en: A lion pops up right behind them. “Hi! I'm León.”
cells.cn: 一头狮子忽然从他们背后冒出来：“嗨，我是 León。”

cells.en: Map says: the swinging forest, the bridge, then the circus.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过“秋千森林”，再走长桥，最后到马戏团。

cells.en: First they go through the swinging forest. Swings, swings everywhere!
cells.cn: 先穿过“秋千森林”，到处都是荡来荡去的秋千。

cells.en: “Put your feet in the air!” They ride on León's back. Whee!
cells.cn: “把脚翘起来！”他们骑在 León 背上，一路飞跑。

cells.en: “Do you see the swings?” “Yes!” They swing across the forest.
cells.cn: “看见秋千了吗？”——“看见了！”他们荡着秋千穿过森林。

cells.en: Then they walk and walk across the long bridge.
cells.cn: 接着他们走上长长的吊桥，一步一步往前走。

cells.en: At the circus León climbs up high. “This is my greatest trick!”
cells.cn: 到了马戏团，León 爬上高高的秋千架：“这是我最好的一招！”

cells.en: “Damas y caballeros, niños y niñas…” The show begins!
cells.cn: “女士们、先生们，小朋友们……”演出开始啦！

cells.en: “Now I'm a real circus lion!” Everyone claps and cheers.
cells.cn: “现在我是一头真正的马戏团狮子了！”全场鼓掌欢呼。

S02E24.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “León, The Circus Lion”.
S02E24.ending: In the end, León does his trick and becomes a real circus lion. My favorite part is ______.

S02E25.title: Whose Birthday Is It?
S02E25.hook: 一路猜是谁过生日，最后气球打开的答案谁也没想到。

cells.en: Dora and Boots see a big birthday balloon in the sky. It has cake inside!
cells.cn: 天上飘来一个生日气球，里面装着蛋糕和彩带。

cells.en: “It's not my birthday,” says Dora. “Not mine!” says Boots. Whose birthday is it?
cells.cn: 不是 Dora 的生日，也不是 Boots 的——那到底是谁的？

cells.en: Map says: “Go over Cupcake Mountain, cross Sneezing Snake Lake, then Play Park.”
cells.cn: 地图指路：翻过纸杯蛋糕山 → 穿过打喷嚏蛇湖 → 到游乐公园。

cells.en: They hear a party blower. It is Tico! But it is not his birthday.
cells.cn: 顺着喇叭声找到 Tico，可这天也不是他的生日。

cells.en: They ride three elevators. They say “¡Vamos!” and up they go.
cells.cn: 坐三部电梯上山顶，喊 “¡Vamos!”（走啦）电梯才动。

cells.en: On the top, they eat cupcakes. “¡Qué rico!” Yum, yum!
cells.cn: 山顶上吃纸杯蛋糕，“¡Qué rico!” 真好吃。

cells.en: They put on lifejackets and get on a raft. A snake comes! Turn the wheel!
cells.cn: 穿上救生衣坐上木筏过湖，看到蛇就赶紧转方向盘。

cells.en: At Play Park, the balloon opens. Surprise! It is Swiper's birthday!
cells.cn: 到了游乐公园，气球打开——原来是 Swiper 的生日！

cells.en: Everyone sings “Happy Birthday” to Swiper. What a fun day!
cells.cn: 大家一起给 Swiper 唱生日歌，真是开心的一天。

S02E25.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Whose Birthday Is It?”
S02E25.ending: In the end, they find out it is Swiper's birthday. My favorite part is ______.

S02E26.title: Super Spies
S02E26.hook: Swiper 要去偷 Isa 的纸杯蛋糕，Dora 和 Boots 变身超级小侦探。

cells.en: “Right! That's Boots, the Super Spy Monkey!” Dora says.
cells.cn: “对！他就是 Boots——超级小侦探猴子！”Dora 说。

cells.en: Backpack gives them spy glasses, a visor and a spy bag. “Cool!”
cells.cn: 背包里掏出侦探眼镜、遮阳帽和侦探包，“太酷了！”

cells.en: Map says: the flowery garden, the boat-car, then Isa's party.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过花花园，再坐小船车，最后到 Isa 的派对。

cells.en: “There it is!” Dora looks through her spy glass. Something moves!
cells.cn: “就在那儿！”Dora 举起侦探镜一看，有东西在动！

cells.en: They ride in the Super Spy Boat-Car. It goes fast on land and water!
cells.cn: 他们坐上“超级侦探船车”，陆地和水上都能飞快前进。

cells.en: “Ready, Super Spy Dora?” “Ready!” They zip down the line.
cells.cn: “准备好了吗，超级小侦探 Dora？”——“出发！”他们顺着滑索飞下去。

cells.en: “We have to warn you!” Isa's cupcakes are on the table.
cells.cn: “我们是来提醒你的！”桌上摆满了 Isa 做的纸杯蛋糕。

cells.en: Swiper tries to grab them, but the super spies stop him. “Oh, man!”
cells.cn: Swiper 刚伸手就被超级小侦探拦住了，“真倒霉！”

cells.en: “We did it!” Boots holds up a cupcake. The party can begin.
cells.cn: “我们做到了！”Boots 举起一个纸杯蛋糕，派对可以开始啦。

S02E26.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Super Spies”.
S02E26.ending: In the end, the super spies save Isa's cupcakes. My favorite part is ______.

S03E01.title: Dora Had A Little Lamb
S03E01.hook: 儿歌书里跳出一只小羊，要把它送回 Mary 家。

cells.en: A little lamb jumps out of the nursery rhyme book! “Where is my Mary?”
cells.cn: 一只小羊从儿歌书里跳了出来：“我的 Mary 在哪儿呀？”

cells.en: Map says: the water, the moon, then Mary's house.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过水，再上月亮，最后到 Mary 家。

cells.en: The water tap turns on! They must find a way across the water.
cells.cn: 大水龙头被拧开了，他们得想办法从水上过去。

cells.en: “Hickory-dickory-dare!” they sing, and the lamb follows them.
cells.cn: 他们边走边唱儿歌，小羊一步不落地跟着。

cells.en: Humpty Dumpty falls off the wall. They put him back together again!
cells.cn: 蛋头先生从墙上摔了下来，他们又把他拼回去了。

cells.en: “The cow speaks Spanish!” The cow jumps over the moon. Moo!
cells.cn: “这头牛会说西班牙语！”它一下子跳过月亮，哞——

cells.en: “I've got to get home fast,” says the lamb. “My Mary is waiting.”
cells.cn: “我得快点回家，”小羊说，“Mary 在等我呢。”

cells.en: “Good rub-a-dub-dubbing!” The nursery rhyme children give them a ride.
cells.cn: “扑通扑通洗个澡！”儿歌里的小朋友们用小车送了他们一程。

cells.en: “Everywhere that you go, Mary.” The lamb is home at last.
cells.cn: “你走到哪儿，我就跟到哪儿，Mary。”小羊终于回家了。

S03E01.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora Had A Little Lamb”.
S03E01.ending: In the end, the little lamb gets back to Mary. My favorite part is ______.

S03E02.title: Stuck Truck
S03E02.hook: 冰淇淋车陷进泥坑出不来，得找拖车把它拉出来。

cells.en: On the screen Dora sees it: the ice cream truck is stuck!
cells.cn: Dora 在屏幕上看到——冰淇淋车陷在坑里出不来了！

cells.en: Map says: the fork in the road, the hill, then the ice cream truck.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先到岔路口，再上小山，最后找到冰淇淋车。

cells.en: The blue truck has ten big wheels. “If you see Swiper, yell ‘Swiper!’”
cells.cn: 蓝色大卡车有十个大轮子，“看到 Swiper 就喊‘Swiper！’”

cells.en: “The piece that goes here!” They fix the road with the right shapes.
cells.cn: “这块该放这儿！”他们把对形状的零件补进路面。

cells.en: “Mira, here's Rojo.” The red fire truck comes to help.
cells.cn: “瞧，Rojo 来了。”红色消防车赶来帮忙。

cells.en: “Yay!” Rollo the yellow tow truck drives up. Now they can pull it out!
cells.cn: “太棒了！”黄色拖车 Rollo 开过来了，这下能把它拉出来了。

cells.en: “Grab the handle and turn it!” The hook goes down to the truck.
cells.cn: “抓住把手，往下转！”吊钩慢慢放到小卡车上。

cells.en: “¡Helados, helados!” The ice cream truck is back on the road.
cells.cn: “卖冰淇淋喽！”冰淇淋车终于回到路上了。

cells.en: All the trucks and all the friends are together. “We did it!”
cells.cn: 所有车和所有朋友都聚在一起：“我们做到了！”

S03E02.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Stuck Truck”.
S03E02.ending: In the end, Rollo pulls the ice cream truck out of the mud. My favorite part is ______.

S03E03.title: Louder!
S03E03.hook: 太阳睡过头了，只有公鸡的喔喔啼能叫醒它——可公鸡嗓子哑了。

cells.en: The sun is still sleeping. Nobody can wake it up this morning!
cells.cn: 太阳还在呼呼大睡，今天早上谁也叫不醒它。

cells.en: “My cock-a-doodle-doo couldn't wake up anybody.” The rooster is hoarse.
cells.cn: “我的喔喔啼谁也吵不醒。”——公鸡的嗓子哑了。

cells.en: Map says: the river, the waterfall, then the Highest Hill.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过河，再过瀑布，最后爬上最高的山。

cells.en: “Say ‘culebra’ — snake!” They get into a little yellow boat.
cells.cn: “跟我说 culebra——蛇！”他们坐上一条黄色小船。

cells.en: “Do you see a snake?” They must stay away from the noisy snakes.
cells.cn: “你看见蛇了吗？”——他们得躲开水里那些吵吵闹闹的蛇。

cells.en: At the waterfall the water splashes. They put on raincoats and boots.
cells.cn: 瀑布下溅起大水花，他们穿上雨衣和雨靴。

cells.en: On the Highest Hill they all crow together. “¡Buenos días!” The sun wakes up!
cells.cn: 在最高的山上大家一起打鸣：“早上好！”太阳终于醒了！

cells.en: “¡Buenos días, pájaros!” All the birds sing in the new day.
cells.cn: “小鸟们，早上好！”鸟儿们在新的清晨里唱起歌。

cells.en: “We couldn't have done it if it weren't for you!” The sun shines again.
cells.cn: “没有你们帮忙可不行！”太阳重新照亮了大地。

S03E03.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Louder!”.
S03E03.ending: In the end, the sun wakes up and the day begins. My favorite part is ______.

S03E04.title: Roberto The Robot
S03E04.hook: 机器人 Roberto 坏了，得找齐零件把他修好，再送他回家。

cells.en: Roberto the robot is broken. He needs batteries and lots of tools.
cells.cn: 机器人 Roberto 坏了，他需要电池，还需要一堆工具。

cells.en: Map says: the bridge, then past the volcano, then Grandpa's house.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过桥，再绕过火山，最后到爷爷家。

cells.en: Roberto climbs up to the tree house. “I can fix myself here!”
cells.cn: Roberto 爬上树屋：“我可以在这里把自己修好！”

cells.en: They come to a long blue bridge. One step, two steps, three!
cells.cn: 他们来到一座长长的蓝桥边，一步一步往前走。

cells.en: “Yeah, there it is.” Roberto walks across the bridge by himself.
cells.cn: “对，就是那儿。”Roberto 自己走过了桥。

cells.en: “Up and down, up and down.” Roberto's legs go up and down.
cells.cn: “上去、下来，上去、下来。”Roberto 的腿一抬一放，走得很稳。

cells.en: Only one place left: Grandpa's house. The volcano is behind them.
cells.cn: 只剩最后一站——爷爷家，火山已经被他们甩在身后。

cells.en: They all ride a big bike together. “Hold on tight!”
cells.cn: 他们一起骑上三人自行车：“抓稳啦！”

cells.en: There is Grandpa's house. “We got Roberto home!” Everyone cheers.
cells.cn: 爷爷家到了。“我们把 Roberto 送回家了！”大家欢呼起来。

S03E04.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Roberto The Robot”.
S03E04.ending: In the end, they bring Roberto back to his grandpa. My favorite part is ______.

S03E05.title: The Big Potato
S03E05.hook: Benny 一觉醒来变成了一颗大土豆，得送他去城堡变回原样。

cells.en: “Hey, where's Benny?” A big potato is standing in his place!
cells.cn: “咦，Benny 呢？”——一颗大土豆站在他刚才的位置上！

cells.en: Map says: the flower garden, the big gate, then the castle.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过花园，再走大门，最后到城堡。

cells.en: The big potato rolls down the hill. “He can keep rolling all the way!”
cells.cn: 大土豆顺着山坡骨碌碌滚下去：“就让他这么一路滚过去吧！”

cells.en: “But, Dora, there's no path through the garden.” The flowers are too tall.
cells.cn: “可是 Dora，花园里没有路呀。”花长得比人还高。

cells.en: A pink dragon is asleep in the way. They sing softly: “La lechuza.”
cells.cn: 一只粉红恐龙挡在路上睡着了，他们轻轻唱起摇篮曲。

cells.en: The castle is very close now. But the gate will not open.
cells.cn: 城堡就在眼前了，可大门怎么也推不开。

cells.en: “Dora needs you to find the wizard's magic wand.” Backpack has it!
cells.cn: “Dora 需要你帮忙找巫师的魔杖。”——背包里正好有！

cells.en: “Say ‘estrellas’ — stars!” The stars light up the way to the castle.
cells.cn: “跟我说 estrellas——星星！”星星亮起来，照出一条通往城堡的路。

cells.en: At the castle the potato turns back into Benny. “We did it!”
cells.cn: 在城堡里，土豆变回了 Benny：“我们做到了！”

S03E05.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Big Potato”.
S03E05.ending: In the end, the big potato turns back into Benny. My favorite part is ______.

S03E06.title: Journey To The Purple Planet
S03E06.hook: 几个小外星人迷路了，Dora 和 Boots 要开火箭送它们回紫色星球。

cells.en: Four little creatures from outer space land in the park. “I promise!”
cells.cn: 四个外星小生物落在公园里，Dora 答应送它们回家。

cells.en: Map says: the Milky Way, the space rocks, then the Purple Planet.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过银河，再穿太空岩石，最后到紫色星球。

cells.en: “Will you count backwards from ten with me?” Ten, nine, eight… blast off!
cells.cn: “跟我一起从十倒数好吗？”十、九、八……发射！

cells.en: The rocket flies up into space. The stars are all around them.
cells.cn: 火箭飞进太空，四周全是闪闪的星星。

cells.en: “To get through the Milky Way, do this way.” They join the stars 1 to 6.
cells.cn: “想过银河，就照这样做。”他们按 1 到 6 把星星连起来。

cells.en: “Rocks…” The space rocks are coming. Everybody holds on tight!
cells.cn: “前面是岩石……”太空碎石飞过来了，大家抓紧！

cells.en: “We made it past all the space rocks!” The Purple Planet is near.
cells.cn: “我们穿过所有太空岩石啦！”紫色星球就在前面。

cells.en: “Whoa!” Dora and Boots step out onto the purple ground.
cells.cn: “哇！”Dora 和 Boots 踩上了紫色的地面。

cells.en: “Home! Home! Home!” The little creatures are home at last.
cells.cn: “家！家！家！”小外星人们终于回到家了。

S03E06.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Journey To The Purple Planet”.
S03E06.ending: In the end, the little creatures get back to the Purple Planet. My favorite part is ______.

S03E07.title: The Lost City
S03E07.hook: 小熊 Osito 跑丢了，Dora 和 Boots 要沿着星星一路找到失落之城。

cells.en: “I can't find him anywhere!” Osito the teddy bear is lost.
cells.cn: “我到处都找不到他！”——小熊 Osito 不见了。

cells.en: Map says: the river, the maze, then the Lost City.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过河，再走迷宫，最后到失落的城市。

cells.en: “Let's put the stars in the star pocket.” Boots catches the stars.
cells.cn: “把星星放进星星口袋。”Boots 把闪亮的星星一颗颗收起来。

cells.en: “Seven, eight, nine. Good counting!” They step on the right stones.
cells.cn: “七、八、九，数得真好！”他们踩着正确的石阶往上走。

cells.en: There it is — a big pyramid with a red path going up.
cells.cn: 找到了——一座大金字塔，一条红色小路盘上去。

cells.en: “Wow, that really was a shortcut.” They crawl through the green tunnel.
cells.cn: “哇，这真是条近路。”他们从绿色的拱洞里爬过去。

cells.en: “No one has ever found the Lost City before!” It is full of toys.
cells.cn: “以前从来没人找到过失落的城市！”里面全是玩具。

cells.en: “¡Allí, Osito!” The teddy bear is sitting on the tile floor.
cells.cn: “Osito 在那儿！”小熊正坐在花砖地上。

cells.en: “Let's see how many stars we caught.” One, two, three… ten!
cells.cn: “看看我们抓了几颗星星。”一、二、三……十颗！

S03E07.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Lost City”.
S03E07.ending: In the end, they find Osito in the Lost City. My favorite part is ______.

S03E08.title: Meet Diego!
S03E08.hook: 小美洲豹困在河心石头上，动物救援员 Diego 来帮忙。

cells.en: A boy zips through the trees. It is Cousin Diego, the animal rescuer!
cells.cn: 一个男孩顺着绳索飞过树林——是表哥 Diego，动物救援员！

cells.en: “Louder!” Dora introduces Boots to Diego. They are going to help animals.
cells.cn: “大声点！”Dora 把 Boots 介绍给 Diego，他们要一起去救动物。

cells.en: “¡Swing, swing, swing!” They swing on vines through the rain forest.
cells.cn: “荡啊、荡啊、荡！”他们抓着藤蔓荡过雨林。

cells.en: “Can't catch us!” They zip across the jungle on the line.
cells.cn: “抓不到我们！”他们顺着滑索一下子飞过丛林。

cells.en: “Ooh, big cave!” The path goes right into a big rocky cave.
cells.cn: “哇，好大的山洞！”小路一直通进一个大岩洞。

cells.en: “We need to find the waterfall!” The baby jaguar is near the water.
cells.cn: “我们得找到瀑布！”小美洲豹就在水边等着。

cells.en: “Bounce, bounce, bounce!” They ride the river dolphin down the water.
cells.cn: “弹、弹、弹！”他们骑着河豚顺流冲下去。

cells.en: “We zipped through the rain forest.” The baby jaguar is safe with its mother.
cells.cn: “我们飞过了雨林。”小美洲豹平安回到妈妈身边。

cells.en: “My favorite part was when we figured out…” Diego gives them badges.
cells.cn: “我最喜欢的是我们一起想办法的时候……”Diego 给他们发救援徽章。

S03E08.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Meet Diego!”.
S03E08.ending: In the end, they save the baby jaguar and get rescuer badges. My favorite part is ______.

S03E09.title: Save The Puppies
S03E09.hook: 狗妈妈的十只小宝宝跑丢了，Dora 和 Boots 要一只一只找回来。

cells.en: “¡Hola!” Mamá Dog has ten puppies. But now they are all lost!
cells.cn: “你好呀！”狗妈妈有十只小宝宝，可现在它们全跑丢了。

cells.en: “We found one puppy!” Dora picks up the little white dog.
cells.cn: “找到一只啦！”Dora 把这只小白狗抱起来。

cells.en: “Let's put them in the star pocket.” Each puppy earns a star.
cells.cn: “把它们放进星星口袋。”每找回一只小狗就亮起一颗星。

cells.en: “We have to get through this doghouse.” They crawl in one by one.
cells.cn: “我们得从这个狗屋里穿过去。”他们一个接一个爬进去。

cells.en: “Uno, dos, tres…” Dora counts the puppies in her arms.
cells.cn: “一、二、三……”Dora 数着怀里的几只小狗。

cells.en: “Look, he found another red box.” A puppy is hiding inside!
cells.cn: “看，他又找到一个红箱子。”里面躲着一只小狗！

cells.en: “We got away from the dogcatcher.” They float down the river.
cells.cn: “我们甩开抓狗人啦。”他们坐着黄色小筏顺流而下。

cells.en: “Super-jump!” Dora and Boots jump high with the puppies.
cells.cn: “超级跳！”Dora、Boots 和小狗们一起跳得高高的。

cells.en: All ten puppies run back to Mamá Dog. “We did it!”
cells.cn: 十只小狗一起跑回狗妈妈身边：“我们做到了！”

S03E09.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Save The Puppies”.
S03E09.ending: In the end, all ten puppies go back to Mamá Dog. My favorite part is ______.

S03E10.title: Por Favor!
S03E10.hook: 要去城堡送王冠，一路上都得会说那句神奇的话：¡Por favor!

cells.en: Once upon a time, in a far away kingdom, the king needs his crown.
cells.cn: 很久很久以前，在一个遥远的王国里，国王需要他的王冠。

cells.en: Map says: the forest, the drawbridge, then the castle.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过森林，再走吊桥，最后到城堡。

cells.en: A big gate is closed. “We have to say ‘open, please.’”
cells.cn: 大门关得紧紧的：“我们得说‘请开一下’。”

cells.en: “A dragon!” It is sleeping on the path. They must be very quiet.
cells.cn: “有条龙！”它睡在小路上，他们得轻轻地走过去。

cells.en: “Where do we go next?” They look at the map again.
cells.cn: “接下来往哪儿走？”他们又看了一遍地图。

cells.en: “I am the lion of Wigamore.” The stone lion guards the stairs.
cells.cn: “我是威格莫尔的狮子。”石狮子守着台阶。

cells.en: “We have to say, ‘Swiper, no swiping.’” And away he goes!
cells.cn: “我们得说‘Swiper，不许抢’。”——他只好走了！

cells.en: “We did it!” The king has his crown, and everyone cheers.
cells.cn: “我们做到了！”国王拿回了王冠，大家一起欢呼。

cells.en: One, two, three, four… seven stars! “¡Por favor!” works every time.
cells.cn: 一、二、三、四……七颗星！“请”这句话每次都管用。

S03E10.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Por Favor!”.
S03E10.ending: In the end, the king gets his crown back. My favorite part is ______.

S03E11.title: Baby Dino
S03E11.hook: 一只蓝色恐龙宝宝在找妈妈，得送它去恐龙岛。

cells.en: “Is it a baby cow?” No, it is a baby dinosaur! It lost its mamá.
cells.cn: “这是小牛吗？”不是，是一只恐龙宝宝——它找不到妈妈了。

cells.en: “I know where Baby Dino's mommy is — at Dino Island.”
cells.cn: “我知道恐龙宝宝的妈妈在哪儿——在恐龙岛。”

cells.en: “These are little Compsognathus dinosaurs.” They are very small and fast.
cells.cn: “这些是小巧的腔骨龙。”它们又小又灵活。

cells.en: “Aw, Baby Dino picked a flower for his mommy.” What a sweet dinosaur!
cells.cn: “哇，恐龙宝宝给妈妈摘了一朵花。”真是只贴心的恐龙。

cells.en: “Will you help us tiptoe past the T. rex?” Shhh — walk softly!
cells.cn: “你能帮我们悄悄走过霸王龙吗？”嘘——脚步要轻！

cells.en: Dino Island is across the water. The big blue dinosaur looks at the sea.
cells.cn: 恐龙岛就在水对面，大蓝恐龙望着海面。

cells.en: “Mommy.” Baby Dino gives the yellow flower to his mother at last.
cells.cn: “妈妈。”恐龙宝宝终于把那朵黄花送到了妈妈手里。

cells.en: “We did it!” Dora and Boots dance with the dinosaur family.
cells.cn: “我们做到了！”Dora 和 Boots 跟恐龙一家一起跳舞。

cells.en: “Una, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco, seis, siete.” Seven stars for today!
cells.cn: “一、二、三、四、五、六、七。”今天得了七颗星！

S03E11.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Baby Dino”.
S03E11.ending: In the end, Baby Dino finds his mommy on Dino Island. My favorite part is ______.

S03E12.title: Boots' Special Day
S03E12.hook: 今天是 Boots 的特别日子，他戴上王冠，想玩什么就玩什么。

cells.en: “We can do anything you want.” Boots has a crown — it is his special day!
cells.cn: “你想玩什么都行。”Boots 戴上了王冠——今天是他的特别日子！

cells.en: Map says: the bouncy park, the stars, then the big ride.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先去蹦蹦公园，再找星星，最后坐大游乐设施。

cells.en: All their friends are waiting with balloons. “Happy special day, Boots!”
cells.cn: 朋友们举着气球在等他：“特别日子快乐，Boots！”

cells.en: “Swiper, no swiping!” The octopus waves and Swiper runs away.
cells.cn: “Swiper，不许抢！”章鱼挥挥手，Swiper 只好跑了。

cells.en: The purple octopus shows them the way to the next ride.
cells.cn: 紫色章鱼给他们指路，告诉他们下一个游乐项目在哪儿。

cells.en: A little orange train puffs by. “Would you like a ride?”
cells.cn: 一列橙色小火车呜呜开过来：“要坐一程吗？”

cells.en: “Wow!” The roller coaster is huge. Boots draws it in the sky.
cells.cn: “哇！”过山车好高呀，Boots 在天上画出了它的样子。

cells.en: Boots and Dora walk home together. “This was the best day!”
cells.cn: Boots 和 Dora 一起走回家：“今天真是最棒的一天！”

cells.en: “¡Gracias!” Boots waves goodbye. A star drops into his hand.
cells.cn: “谢谢！”Boots 挥手告别，一颗星星落进他手心。

S03E12.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Boots' Special Day”.
S03E12.ending: In the end, Boots says it was the best day ever. My favorite part is ______.

S03E13.title: To The South Pole
S03E13.hook: 一只小企鹅走丢了，Dora 和 Diego 要坐飞机把它送回南极的家。

cells.en: “We need to say hello to the penguin.” A little penguin is far from home.
cells.cn: “我们得跟小企鹅打个招呼。”这只小企鹅离家的路太远了。

cells.en: Map says: the icy water, the icebergs, then the South Pole.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过冰水，再翻冰山，最后到南极。

cells.en: “Yeah, let's go!” They fly off in a little yellow plane.
