cells.cn: “好，出发！”他们坐上一架黄色小飞机。

cells.en: It is very cold. They put on big coats, boots and gloves.
cells.cn: 那里冷得很，他们穿上厚外套、雪地靴和手套。

cells.en: A long chain goes across the icy water. They hold on and go.
cells.cn: 一条长链子横过冰水，他们抓紧链子往前挪。

cells.en: “If you see a seal, clap and say…” They keep their eyes open.
cells.cn: “看到海豹就拍手说……”他们睁大眼睛盯着冰面。

cells.en: “Okay, little penguin, here we go.” They climb up the iceberg.
cells.cn: “好啦小企鹅，我们走。”他们一起爬上冰山。

cells.en: “Say ‘ork, ork!’” Hundreds of penguins are waiting at the South Pole.
cells.cn: “跟我叫 ork、ork！”南极有几百只企鹅在等着。

cells.en: “I liked that, too.” The little penguin is home with its family.
cells.cn: “我也喜欢那一段。”小企鹅终于和家人团聚了。

S03E13.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “To The South Pole”.
S03E13.ending: In the end, the little penguin finds its family at the South Pole. My favorite part is ______.

S03E14.title: Dora Saves The Game
S03E14.hook: 黄队少了一个球员，比赛马上就要开始了，Dora 得赶紧赶到球场。

cells.en: “We're ready to start today's big soccer game!” But one player is missing.
cells.cn: “今天的足球大赛马上开始！”可黄队还少一个人。

cells.en: Map says: the river, the bridge, then the soccer field.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过河，再过桥，最后到球场。

cells.en: “You need to say the Spanish word ‘salta’ — jump!” Up they go.
cells.cn: “跟我说这个西班牙语词 salta——跳！”他们一下子跳上去。

cells.en: A wagon full of balls rolls away. They must catch every ball!
cells.cn: 装满球的小车骨碌碌滚走了，他们得把球一个个追回来。

cells.en: “¡Corre, Dora, corre!” Run, Dora, run! The horses run with her.
cells.cn: “跑呀 Dora，快跑！”马儿跟着她一起飞奔。

cells.en: “Count with me.” The giant otters help them cross the river.
cells.cn: “跟我一起数。”大水獭帮他们过了河。

cells.en: “Dora, Dora, Dora!” Diego and Boots cheer her on.
cells.cn: “Dora！Dora！Dora！”Diego 和 Boots 大声给她加油。

cells.en: Dora runs onto the field in her yellow shirt and kicks the ball.
cells.cn: Dora 穿上黄色球衣冲进球场，一脚把球踢了出去。

cells.en: “Then the giant otters helped us fix the bridge.” The Yellow Team wins!
cells.cn: “后来大水獭帮我们修好了桥。”黄队赢啦！

S03E14.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora Saves The Game”.
S03E14.ending: In the end, the Yellow Team wins the game. My favorite part is ______.

S03E15.title: BOO!
S03E15.hook: 万圣节的晚上，Dora 扮成小猫、Boots 扮成海盗，一起去要糖果。

cells.en: “There's Boots.” He is a pirate with a goody bag. “Happy Halloween!”
cells.cn: “Boots 在那儿。”他扮成海盗，手里提着糖果袋：“万圣节快乐！”

cells.en: Map says: the pumpkin patch, then the Good Witch's forest.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过南瓜地，再穿好心女巫的森林。

cells.en: “To get through the patch…” A scarecrow stands in the pumpkins.
cells.cn: “要穿过南瓜地……”一个稻草人立在南瓜堆里。

cells.en: Pumpkins, witch, house. “Which one comes next?” The witch!
cells.cn: 南瓜地、女巫、房子——“下一个是哪一个？”是女巫！

cells.en: “What's his costume?” He is dressed as a big pink pig. Oink!
cells.cn: “他扮的是什么？”——一头粉红色的大猪。哼哼！

cells.en: A white ghost floats out of the trees. “Boo!” they all shout.
cells.cn: 一只白幽灵从树后飘出来，大家一起喊：“哇！”

cells.en: “To fly through the forest, we'd better hang on tight!”
cells.cn: “要飞过森林，我们最好抓稳一点！”

cells.en: “I'm home, I'm home!” The purple monsters run to their door.
cells.cn: “我回来啦，我回来啦！”紫色小怪物跑向自己家门口。

cells.en: Even Swiper gets a goody bag. “Happy Halloween to all!”
cells.cn: 连 Swiper 也拿到了糖果袋：“祝大家万圣节快乐！”

S03E15.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “BOO!”.
S03E15.ending: In the end, everyone gets candy on Halloween night. My favorite part is ______.

S03E16.title: What Happens Next?
S03E16.hook: 童话书的结尾全掉了，Dora 和 Boots 要走进故事里，把「后来呢」找回来告诉国王。

cells.en: “Hola!” Dora opens her story book. But every ending is missing!
cells.cn: “你好！”Dora 翻开童话书——可每个故事的结尾都不见了！

cells.en: The wolf huffs and puffs, but the little pig's brick house does not fall down.
cells.cn: 大灰狼又吹又吼，可小猪的砖房子一点儿也没倒。

cells.en: “Oh, thank you, thank you, King.” The little pig is safe in his new house.
cells.cn: “谢谢您，谢谢您，国王。”小猪在新房子里很安全。

cells.en: Dora and Boots run up the green hill. “We have to get to the castle!”
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 跑上绿色的小山坡：“我们得赶到城堡去！”

cells.en: “I wanted to sit down, but I broke one of your chairs,” says Baby Bear.
cells.cn: 小熊说：“我想坐下来，可是把你们的一把椅子坐坏了。”

cells.en: “We made it!” Dora and Boots knock on the big wooden door of the castle.
cells.cn: “我们到啦！”Dora 和 Boots 敲响城堡那扇大木门。

cells.en: Map says: the story house, then the tall tree, and the rainbow by the castle.
cells.cn: 地图说：先到故事小屋，再到那棵高树，最后是城堡边的彩虹。

cells.en: Backpack has a spoon, a crayon, a whistle, a lollipop and a bubble wand.
cells.cn: 背包里有勺子、蜡笔、哨子、棒棒糖和吹泡泡棒。

cells.en: The King and Queen clap. “Now we know what happens next!” A rainbow shines.
cells.cn: 国王和王后鼓掌：“现在我们知道了后来发生了什么！”彩虹亮起来。

S03E16.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “What Happens Next?”.
S03E16.ending: In the end, Dora finds every missing ending and tells the King. My favorite part is ______.

S03E17.title: Rescue, Rescue, Rescue
S03E17.hook: Dora 和 Boots 救完一个又一个：树枝上的美洲豹宝宝、沙坑里的小犰狳、还有喷泉上的公牛。

cells.en: “Help! Help!” Dora and Boots hear someone calling. It is time to rescue!
cells.cn: “救命！救命！”Dora 和 Boots 听见有人呼救，出发救援的时刻到了！

cells.en: Baby Jaguar is hanging on by his little claws, high up on a branch.
cells.cn: 美洲豹宝宝只用小爪子挂着，吊在高高的树枝上。

cells.en: Map shows the way: the tall tree, the sandy hole, and the Gooey Geyser.
cells.cn: 地图指路：高高的树、沙坑，还有黏黏的喷泉。

cells.en: “Say Backpack!” Out come a net, a rope, sticky tape and a big horn.
cells.cn: “说背包！”——网、绳子、黏胶带，还有一个大喇叭都出来了。

cells.en: Red ants march along the cliff. The little armadillo is stuck down there.
cells.cn: 红蚂蚁沿着崖边排队走，小犰狳被困在下面的沙坑里。

cells.en: “Climb, climb, climb!” They pull the ladder up and climb out.
cells.cn: “爬呀爬，爬呀爬！”他们把梯子拉上来，一起爬了出去。

cells.en: “Benny! Benny!” Benny the bull is sitting on top of the Gooey Geyser.
cells.cn: “Benny！Benny！”公牛 Benny 正坐在黏黏喷泉的顶上。

cells.en: They tape the big balloon to the basket. Benny floats up and away!
cells.cn: 他们把大气球粘在篮子上，Benny 就飘起来飞走了！

cells.en: “We did it!” Dora holds Baby Jaguar. Everyone is safe now.
cells.cn: “我们做到啦！”Dora 抱着美洲豹宝宝，大家现在都安全了。

S03E17.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Rescue, Rescue, Rescue”.
S03E17.ending: In the end, Dora and Boots rescue Baby Jaguar, the armadillo and Benny. My favorite part is ______.

S03E18.title: Boots' Cuddly Dinosaur
S03E18.hook: 天黑了，Boots 睡不着——他的恐龙玩偶忘在游乐场了。Dora 陪他摸黑去找。

cells.en: “I never go to sleep without my dinosaur,” says Boots. But where is it?
cells.cn: “我没有恐龙玩偶就睡不着。”Boots 说。可它在哪儿呢？

cells.en: “We were at Play Park, remember?” Boots left it there in the afternoon.
cells.cn: “我们下午去过游乐园，记得吗？”Boots 把它落在那里了。

cells.en: “I'm the Map!” The red barn, then the playground. That is the way.
cells.cn: “我是地图！”先过红色谷仓，再到游乐场——这就是路线。

cells.en: “Dora, I really miss that dinosaur.” The sky turns orange and dark.
cells.cn: “Dora，我真的好想那只恐龙。”天边慢慢变成橘红色，越来越暗。

cells.en: Boots looks in the barn window. “Hey… it's dark in there.”
cells.cn: Boots 往谷仓的窗户里看：“嘿……里面好黑啊。”

cells.en: It is dark and full of hay. The mice count: one, two, three, four…
cells.cn: 里面又黑又堆满干草，小老鼠们数着：一、二、三、四……

cells.en: A little star twinkles in the sky. “I hope all your wishes come true.”
cells.cn: 天上有一颗小星星在闪：“我希望你所有的心愿都成真。”

cells.en: In the sandbox, next to the big ball, Dora sees the orange dinosaur!
cells.cn: 在沙坑里、大皮球旁边，Dora 看见了那只橘色的小恐龙！

cells.en: Back in bed, Boots hugs his dinosaur. “Good night, Boots!”
cells.cn: 回到床上，Boots 抱着他的小恐龙：“晚安，Boots！”

S03E18.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Boots' Cuddly Dinosaur”.
S03E18.ending: In the end, Dora and Boots find the dinosaur in the sandbox and go back to bed. My favorite part is ______.

S03E19.title: The Super Silly Fiesta
S03E19.hook: 大红鸡的「超级傻派对」要开始了，Dora 和 Boots 一路猜声音、唱歌、做鬼脸赶过去。

cells.en: “I can't wait to see!” Dora has an invitation to the Super Silly Fiesta.
cells.cn: “我迫不及待想去看啦！”Dora 收到了「超级傻派对」的请帖。

cells.en: Map shows the boat, the gate, and the hill with the fiesta on top.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先坐小船，再过大黄门，最后爬上开派对的小山。

cells.en: “Row? Is that right?” Dora and Boots paddle down the river.
cells.cn: “划船？这样对吗？”Dora 和 Boots 一起顺着河划下去。

cells.en: “Will you help us figure out the animals' sounds?” Moo! Oink!
cells.cn: “你能帮我们听出这些动物的叫声吗？”哞——！哼——！

cells.en: “We need to sing it the right way!” The gate only opens for a song.
cells.cn: “我们得唱对才行！”这扇门只听对了歌才打开。

cells.en: Look up! Silly animals hide in the tree. “Let's keep looking.”
cells.cn: 抬头看！傻乎乎的动物们躲在树上：“我们继续找吧。”

cells.en: “Can you make a super silly face?” Everyone laughs out loud.
cells.cn: “你能做一个超傻的鬼脸吗？”大家都哈哈大笑。

cells.en: The Big Red Chicken brings out a giant cake with candles on top.
cells.cn: 大红鸡端出一个大蛋糕，上面插着蜡烛。

cells.en: “We did it!” Everyone dances at the Super Silly Fiesta. What a day!
cells.cn: “我们做到啦！”大家在超级傻派对上跳舞，真是开心的一天！

S03E19.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Super Silly Fiesta”.
S03E19.ending: In the end, Dora and Boots get to the Super Silly Fiesta and dance with the Big Red Chicken. My favorite part is ______.

S03E20.title: The Fix-It Machine
S03E20.hook: Boots 的红靴子破了个洞，Dora 带他去找那台什么都能修的「超级修东西机器」。

cells.en: “I'm hiding!” Dora plays hide and seek in the jungle with Boots.
cells.cn: “我在躲呢！”Dora 和 Boots 在丛林里玩捉迷藏。

cells.en: “My boot!” Boots looks down. His red boot has a big hole in it.
cells.cn: “我的靴子！”Boots 低头一看，红靴子上破了一个大洞。

cells.en: “You just put in your boot,” and the machine will fix it right up.
cells.cn: “只要把靴子放进去，”机器就会把它修好。

cells.en: Map says: first go across Crocodile Lake, then to the Fix-It Machine.
cells.cn: 地图说：先穿过鳄鱼湖，再到修东西机器那儿。

cells.en: Everybody rows the boat. “Put your hands out in front of you!”
cells.cn: 大家一起划船：“把手伸到前面去！”

cells.en: A big furry troll sits on a log and eats a big piece of cheese.
cells.cn: 一个毛茸茸的大巨魔坐在木头上，啃着一大块奶酪。

cells.en: “It will take anything and fix it right up.” The old man smiles.
cells.cn: “不管什么，它都能修得好好的。”老爷爷笑着说。

cells.en: “My boot, my boot!” The old man gives Boots his red boot back.
cells.cn: “我的靴子，我的靴子！”老爷爷把红靴子还给 Boots。

cells.en: “We did it!” Confetti flies. Everything is fixed and everyone is happy.
cells.cn: “我们做到啦！”彩纸飞舞，东西全修好了，大家都很开心。

S03E20.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Fix-It Machine”.
S03E20.ending: In the end, the old man fixes Boots' boot with the machine. My favorite part is ______.

S03E21.title: Baseball Boots
S03E21.hook: Boots 想参加大棒球赛，可他总打不中球。Dora 陪他一路练习，还找到了教练。

cells.en: Dora has a glove and a cap. “You get to catch the ball, too.”
cells.cn: Dora 戴好帽子和手套：“你也要去接球哦。”

cells.en: Boots holds the bat and sings, “When I hit the baseball, all will cheer.”
cells.cn: Boots 举着球棒唱：“等我打中棒球，大家都会为我欢呼。”

cells.en: “Who's the guy you need to know when you've got a place to go?” Map!
cells.cn: “想去一个地方，要问谁呢？”——地图！

cells.en: Six baseballs sit on the board. “Count with me in Spanish!”
cells.cn: 计分板上有六个棒球：“跟我用西班牙语数一数！”

cells.en: “To open this gate, find the green square.” A turtle swims by.
cells.cn: “要开这扇门，先找到绿色的正方形。”一只乌龟游了过来。

cells.en: Backpack, Backpack! Out come a mitt, a ball, tape and a bat.
cells.cn: 背包，背包！——手套、棒球、胶带和球棒都出来了。

cells.en: The coach says, “Remember, Boots. You have three tries to hit the ball.”
cells.cn: 教练说：“记住，Boots，你有三次机会打到球。”

cells.en: “When you see the ball, yell Pelota!” Boots stands at the plate.
cells.cn: “看到球就喊 Pelota（球）！”Boots 站到了击球位上。

cells.en: “Four stars!” Dora and Boots jump and cheer after the big game.
cells.cn: “四颗星星！”大比赛结束后，Dora 和 Boots 又跳又欢呼。

S03E21.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Baseball Boots”.
S03E21.ending: In the end, Boots plays in the big baseball game and everybody cheers for him. My favorite part is ______.

S03E22.title: Best Friends
S03E22.hook: 今天是「好朋友节」。Dora 提着一篮草莓，要跟最好的朋友 Boots 到彩虹岩一起分享。

cells.en: It is Best Friends Day! Dora will share her favorite things with Boots.
cells.cn: 今天是好朋友节！Dora 要把自己最喜欢的东西分享给 Boots。

cells.en: “Who do we ask for help when we don't know which way to go?”
cells.cn: “不知道往哪边走的时候，我们该问谁呢？”

cells.en: Map says the gate comes first, then Rainbow Rock with the rainbow.
cells.cn: 地图说：先过那扇大门，再到有彩虹的彩虹岩。

cells.en: “Happy Best Friends Day, Boots.” A funny tree drops chocolate for them.
cells.cn: “好朋友节快乐，Boots。”一棵怪树给他们掉下了巧克力。

cells.en: Boots looks at two pictures and asks, “Where do we go first?”
cells.cn: Boots 看着两张图问：“我们先去哪儿呢？”

cells.en: A big yellow key sits on the wall. The gate has a yellow lock.
cells.cn: 墙上插着一把大黄钥匙，大门上还有一个黄色的锁。

cells.en: Backpack has scissors, rope, tape, a ladder and a net. “Smart looking!”
cells.cn: 背包里有剪刀、绳子、胶带、梯子和网：“看得真仔细！”

cells.en: Under the big rainbow they share the basket. “Sweet, yummy strawberries!”
cells.cn: 在大彩虹下面，他们一起分享篮子里的草莓：“好甜、好好吃！”

cells.en: Dora and Boots hold hands. “You are my best friend, Boots.” Happy day!
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 手拉手：“你是我最好的朋友，Boots。”开心的一天！

S03E22.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Best Friends”.
S03E22.ending: In the end, Dora and Boots sit under the rainbow and share the strawberries. My favorite part is ______.

S03E23.title: ABC Animals
S03E23.hook: 字母书里的动物全跑出来了！Dora 和 Boots 顺着 A、B、C 一路把动物找回来。

cells.en: Dora opens her big ABC book. “A, B, C, D, E, F, G!”
cells.cn: Dora 翻开大大的字母书：“A、B、C、D、E、F、G！”

cells.en: An armadillo jumps out of the book and runs away! “Armadillo!”
cells.cn: 一只犰狳从书里跳出来跑掉了：“犰狳！”

cells.en: Big letters stand along the path. A is for apple, B is for…?
cells.cn: 路边立着大大的字母。A 是 apple（苹果），B 是什么呢？

cells.en: A white shape appears. “What animal's missing that starts with B?”
cells.cn: 出现一个白色的影子：“少了哪只以 B 开头的动物？”

cells.en: A red fire truck drives past the trees. “F is for fire truck!”
cells.cn: 一辆红色消防车从树旁开过：“F 就是 fire truck（消防车）！”

cells.en: The armadillo finds his old friend, a white quetzal on a rock.
cells.cn: 犰狳找到了老朋友——一只站在石头上的白色凤尾绿咬鹃。

cells.en: “What animal's missing that starts with X?” An x-ray fish swims by.
cells.cn: “少了哪只以 X 开头的动物？”一条 X 光鱼游了过来。

cells.en: Kangaroo, bear, giraffe and zebra are back. “Hip, hip, hooray!”
cells.cn: 袋鼠、熊、长颈鹿和斑马都回来了：“好耶，好耶！”

cells.en: “We did it!” Seven stars shine and all the animals are home again.
cells.cn: “我们做到啦！”七颗星星亮起来，动物们全都回家了。

S03E23.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “ABC Animals”.
S03E23.ending: In the end, Dora and Boots put all the ABC animals back in the book. My favorite part is ______.

S03E24.title: Job Day
S03E24.hook: 今天是「职业日」。Dora 画下了长大想做的事，还坐上消防车、赶到金字塔，体验各种工作。

cells.en: “I want to be an astronaut,” says Dora, “so I can study the stars.”
cells.cn: “我长大想当宇航员，”Dora 说，“这样就能研究星星了。”

cells.en: Map says: the farmhouse, then the blue bridge, then the big pyramid.
cells.cn: 地图说：先过农舍，再走蓝色小桥，最后到大金字塔。

cells.en: “Where is the firehouse?” Dora and Boots look down the long path.
cells.cn: “消防局在哪儿呢？”Dora 和 Boots 顺着长长的小路望去。

cells.en: They ride in the red fire truck. “Seat belts, everybody!” Off they go.
cells.cn: 他们坐上红色消防车：“大家系好安全带！”出发啦。

cells.en: Backpack has a stethoscope, a flashlight, a whistle and a brush.
cells.cn: 背包里有听诊器、手电筒、哨子和刷子。

cells.en: The pyramid has empty shapes. “A triangle, right!” They fill it in.
cells.cn: 金字塔上留着一块块空形状：“是三角形，对吧！”他们把它补上。

cells.en: Some little hens want to cross the road. “We need someone to help!”
cells.cn: 几只小母鸡想过马路：“我们需要有人来帮忙！”

cells.en: “He's going to try to swipe the jewel!” Not this time, Swiper!
cells.cn: “他要去偷那颗宝石了！”这次可不行，Swiper！

cells.en: “We couldn't have done it without you!” Everyone learned about jobs.
cells.cn: “没有你我们可做不到！”今天每个人都认识了新的职业。

S03E24.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Job Day”.
S03E24.ending: In the end, Dora and Boots get to the pyramid and everyone talks about their jobs. My favorite part is ______.

S03E25.title: Dora's Pirate Adventure
S03E25.hook: Dora 和朋友们要演一出海盗剧，可海盗服装不见了！他们真的扬帆出海，去把宝箱找回来。

cells.en: “Let's put on a pirate play!” Dora and all her friends are ready.
cells.cn: “我们来演一出海盗剧吧！”Dora 和朋友们都准备好了。

cells.en: “We can't do the play without our pirate costumes!” Oh no!
cells.cn: “没有海盗服装，我们就演不成了！”糟糕！

cells.en: “The Pirate Piggies took the treasure chest!” Map shows Treasure Island.
cells.cn: “海盗小猪们把宝箱拿走了！”地图上画着宝藏岛的位置。

cells.en: The pirate ship sails across the sea. Everybody stands on the deck.
cells.cn: 海盗船在大海上航行，大家都站在甲板上。

cells.en: In the foggy fog they meet Silly Bird, a funny green parrot.
cells.cn: 在大雾里，他们遇到了 Silly Bird——一只好玩的绿鹦鹉。

cells.en: “Isa, turn the wheel!” Isa helps the ship go the right way.
cells.cn: “Isa，转方向盘！”Isa 帮船开到了正确的方向。

cells.en: “Give us back the treasure!” “No, we won't!” say the pirate piggies.
cells.cn: “把宝藏还给我们！”“才不呢！”海盗小猪们说。

cells.en: There it is! The treasure chest is open, full of bright colors.
cells.cn: 找到啦！宝箱打开了，里面全是亮闪闪的颜色。

cells.en: “I liked that, too.” The pirate play is a big hit with everyone.
cells.cn: “我也喜欢那一段。”这出海盗剧大受大家欢迎。

S03E25.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora's Pirate Adventure”.
S03E25.ending: In the end, Dora and her friends get the treasure chest back and put on their pirate play. My favorite part is ______.

S04E01.title: Star Catcher
S04E01.hook: 天上掉下一颗小星星，Dora 要把它们收进星星口袋，再一路送到云中城堡。

cells.en: “A star catcher!” Dora and Boots want to catch the little star.
cells.cn: “捕星者！”Dora 和 Boots 想去抓住那颗小星星。

cells.en: Boots wants to put the star in the star pocket.
cells.cn: Boots 想把星星放进星星口袋里。

cells.en: Map says: water, mountain, then the cloud castle.
cells.cn: 地图说：先水路，再上山，最后到云中城堡。

cells.en: A little star walks to the boat on the dock.
cells.cn: 一颗小星星走到码头的小船边。

cells.en: “Salta!” The explorer star jumps with them over the sharks.
cells.cn: “Salta（跳）！”探险星和他们一起跳过鲨鱼群。

cells.en: Now they see Dragon Mountain with many stars around.
cells.cn: 这会儿他们看见了恐龙山，周围全是星星。

cells.en: Azul the dragon gives them a ride over Dragon Mountain.
cells.cn: 小龙 Azul 驮着他们飞过龙火山。

cells.en: Look up! There is a castle in the clouds.
cells.cn: 抬头看！云里有一座城堡。

cells.en: The king says, “You are a great star catcher!”
cells.cn: 国王说：“你真是了不起的抓星星高手！”

S04E01.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Star Catcher”.
S04E01.ending: In the end, Dora brings every star to the cloud castle. My favorite part is ______.

S04E02.title: Dora's First Trip
S04E02.hook: Boots 想知道他们是怎么认识的，Dora 就讲起第一次出门送乐器的那趟旅行。

cells.en: Boots asks Dora to tell their very first story.
cells.cn: Boots 请 Dora 讲一讲他们最初的故事。

cells.en: Swiper takes the red boots. “Swiper, no swiping!”
cells.cn: Swiper 抢走红靴子。“Swiper，不许抢！”

cells.en: Will you help us return the instruments to the Fiesta Trio?
cells.cn: 你愿意帮我们把乐器还给 fiesta 三人组吗？

cells.en: First stop is the tallest mountain in the world.
cells.cn: 第一站是全世界最高的山。

cells.en: Tico turns his bike in a circle. Whew, that was so close!
cells.cn: Tico 把车转了个圈，好险！

cells.en: Green frogs peek out from the flowers by the road.
cells.cn: 绿青蛙从路边的花丛里探出头。

cells.en: Boots says, do not worry, I know what to do, with a big smile.
cells.cn: Boots 笑着说：“别担心，我知道该怎么做。”

cells.en: Benny, Isa and Tico all jump into the car.
cells.cn: Benny、Isa 和 Tico 都跳上了小车。

cells.en: The Fiesta Trio plays again: “Buzz-buzz, buzz-buzz!”
cells.cn: Fiesta Trio 又演奏起来：“嗡嗡，嗡嗡！”

S04E02.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora's First Trip”.
S04E02.ending: In the end, the music comes back and Dora meets Boots for the first time. My favorite part is ______.

S04E03.title: Star Mountain
S04E03.hook: Swiper 抢走了 Dora 的项链，一路跑上星星山，追回去要过数字台阶和大雪球。

cells.en: Swiper takes Dora's necklace and runs away fast.
cells.cn: Swiper 抢走 Dora 的项链，飞快地跑掉了。

cells.en: Map shows a big star on top of Star Mountain.
cells.cn: 地图上，星星山的山顶有一颗大星星。

cells.en: It is Tool Star! He has a crowbar and a pencil in the fog.
cells.cn: 是工具星！雾里他带着撬棍和铅笔。

cells.en: There are numbers on the steps from six to fifteen.
cells.cn: 台阶上写着数字，从六一直到十五。

cells.en: Now they need to find the shiny diamond.
cells.cn: 现在他们得找到那颗闪闪的钻石。

cells.en: They climb over the giant snowball in snow clothes.
cells.cn: 他们穿着雪地服翻过那个巨大的雪球。

cells.en: They climbed the diamond. Map says, “Check!”
cells.cn: 他们爬过了钻石那一站，地图说：“打勾！”

cells.en: Backpack gives them a short and a long rope.
cells.cn: 背包掏出两根绳子，一短一长。

cells.en: Thanks for helping us stop Swiper on the tall mountain.
cells.cn: 谢谢你帮我们在高山上拦住了 Swiper。

S04E03.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Star Mountain”.
S04E03.ending: In the end, Dora gets her necklace back on top of Star Mountain. My favorite part is ______.

S04E04.title: Super Spies 2: The Swiping Machine
S04E04.hook: Swiper 造了一台“偷东西机器”，要把生日会上的礼物全抢走，两个小间谍得赶在派对开始前关掉它。

cells.en: Dora and Boots are spies. They have cool new spy gear.
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 是小间谍，他们带着崭新的间谍装备出发了。

cells.en: Tico's having a birthday party with cake and many presents.
cells.cn: Tico 要开生日会了，桌上有蛋糕和好多礼物。

cells.en: “We've got to stop him!” Swiper has a swiping machine.
cells.cn: “我们必须拦住他！”Swiper 造了一台偷东西的机器。

cells.en: Map says: first go down the underground river, then the bridge.
cells.cn: 地图说：先顺地下河漂流，再走那座桥。

cells.en: Swiper presses his superfast button, so the water rushes fast.
cells.cn: Swiper 按下“超快”按钮，河水一下子变得飞快。

cells.en: The tunnel is dark and has twisty paths inside the cave.
cells.cn: 山洞里的隧道又黑又弯，小路绕来绕去。

cells.en: “We got it up to ten!” Dora rides the spy bike fast.
cells.cn: “我们数到十啦！”Dora 骑着间谍自行车飞快前进。

cells.en: “Swiper, no swiping!” Swiper swings over the party table.
cells.cn: “Swiper，不许抢！”Swiper 吊在绳子上从派对桌子上方荡过去。

cells.en: “It's a camera that looks like a butterfly!” Everyone laughs.
cells.cn: “这是一台蝴蝶形状的相机！”大家笑成一团。

S04E04.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Super Spies 2: The Swiping Machine”.
S04E04.ending: In the end, the spies stop the swiping machine and the party is safe. My favorite part is ______.

S04E05.title: La Maestra de Musica
S04E05.hook: 音乐老师的自行车上装满了乐器，Dora 和 Boots 要护送她赶到学校。

cells.en: “My music teacher always sings a special song,” says Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“我的音乐老师总是唱一首特别的歌。”

cells.en: “Maestra, we have a map!” Dora shows the map to her teacher.
cells.cn: “老师，我们有地图！”Dora 把地图拿给音乐老师看。

cells.en: “That's the school bell!” They must hurry to the school.
cells.cn: “上课铃响了！”他们得赶快赶到学校。

cells.en: “How can we get through all these trees?” asks the Maestra.
cells.cn: “我们怎么穿过这么多树呢？”音乐老师问。

cells.en: “Can you say culebras?” They zip over the trees on a bar.
cells.cn: “你能说 culebras（蛇）吗？”他们抓着滑杆从树林上空溜过去。

cells.en: “Las abejas in the trees go buzz, buzz, buzz!” sing the bees.
cells.cn: “树上的蜜蜂嗡嗡嗡！”蜜蜂跟着他们一路唱。

cells.en: “He'll try to swipe la Maestra's guitarra!” warns Diego.
cells.cn: “他会来抢老师的吉他！”Diego 提醒他们。

cells.en: “Are you ready to sing the Hola, Hola song?” asks the Maestra.
cells.cn: “准备好唱《Hola, Hola》了吗？”老师问大家。

cells.en: The whole class sings together in the music room. ¡Muy bien!
cells.cn: 全班同学在音乐教室里一起唱歌，太棒了！

S04E05.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “La Maestra de Musica”.
S04E05.ending: In the end, the whole class sings the Hola, Hola song together. My favorite part is ______.

S04E06.title: Daisy, La Quinceanera
S04E06.hook: Daisy 的十五岁生日派对要开始了，Dora 和 Boots 要穿过玉米迷宫赶到会场。

cells.en: “Circle your hands!” Dora and Boots practice the dance at home.
cells.cn: “转一转手！”Dora 和 Boots 在家练习跳这支舞。

cells.en: The map shows the way: “That's how you get to Daisy's party!”
cells.cn: 地图指路：“这样就能走到 Daisy 的派对啦！”

cells.en: A big duck walks with them. “Who's inside that duck suit?”
cells.cn: 一只大鸭子跟着他们一起走：“是谁穿着那件鸭子衣服呀？”

cells.en: “Círculo or triángulo?” They must pick the right way in the maze.
cells.cn: “圆形还是三角形？”他们要在迷宫里选对路。

cells.en: “The rain forest... right!” Dora points the right way to go.
cells.cn: “雨林……往右！”Dora 指出了正确的方向。

cells.en: “It's up in the treetops, but it's so high up!” she says.
cells.cn: “东西在树顶上，可是太高了！”她说。

cells.en: “Swiper, no swiping!” Swiper stops and gives the umbrella back.
cells.cn: “Swiper，不许抢！”Swiper 停下来，把雨伞还了回去。

cells.en: At the party, Daisy wears a white dress. “She's so beautiful!”
cells.cn: 派对上，Daisy 穿着白色长裙：“她真漂亮！”

cells.en: “Now march in place!” Everyone dances at Daisy's quinceañera.
cells.cn: “原地踏步走！”大家在 Daisy 的十五岁生日派对上一齐跳舞。

S04E06.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Daisy, La Quinceanera”.
S04E06.ending: In the end, everyone dances at Daisy's quinceañera. My favorite part is ______.

S04E07.title: Save Diego
S04E07.hook: Diego 被困在高高的岩壁上，Dora 和 Boots 要找最会爬高的动物去救他。

cells.en: Diego loves helping animals. Baby Jaguar is his best friend.
cells.cn: Diego 最爱帮助动物，小美洲豹是他最好的朋友。

cells.en: “You have to say mira!” Dora says. Mira means look!
cells.cn: “你要说 mira！”Dora 说。mira 就是“看”的意思。

cells.en: Map shows the way: the river, then Iguana Rock, then Diego.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先顺着河走，再到鬣蜥岩，最后找到 Diego。

cells.en: “The mountain goat wants to help us save Diego!” They ride on her back.
cells.cn: “山羊愿意帮我们去救 Diego！”他们骑到山羊的背上。

cells.en: Dora and Boots paddle the raft down the river. Splash!
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 划着皮筏顺流而下，哗——

cells.en: “And fast!” They must climb the rocky wall to reach Diego.
cells.cn: “而且要快！”他们得快快爬上岩壁去找 Diego。

cells.en: “Baby Jaguar will lead us to Diego!” says Dora.
cells.cn: “小美洲豹会带我们去找 Diego！”Dora 说。

cells.en: “We need an animal that is a really good climber,” says Dora.
cells.cn: “我们需要一只特别会爬高的动物。”Dora 说。

cells.en: Diego is safe now. “They just want food,” he says.
cells.cn: Diego 终于安全了：“它们原来只是想吃东西。”

S04E07.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Save Diego”.
S04E07.ending: In the end, Diego is safe and the goat finds food. My favorite part is ______.

S04E08.title: Baby Jaguar's Roar
S04E08.hook: 小美洲豹还不会吼，Dora 和 Diego 带他一路爬过石头、渡过河，去山顶学本领。

cells.en: “His name is Baby Bear,” says Diego. “He is my new friend.”
cells.cn: “他叫小熊宝宝，”Diego 说，“他是我的新朋友。”

cells.en: Map sings: “Say it with me!” The path, the river, the mountain.
cells.cn: 地图唱：“跟我一起说！”小路、大河、高山。

cells.en: “Climb, climb, climb!” They go up the rocks one by one.
cells.cn: “爬呀，爬呀，爬！”他们一块一块石头往上爬。

cells.en: “A red path and a yellow path. Amarillo!” Dora picks yellow.
cells.cn: “一条红路，一条黄路。amarillo！”Dora 选了黄色的那条。

cells.en: Dora and Boots sit with Baby Jaguar in the green jungle.
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 在绿绿的林子里陪着小美洲豹。

cells.en: “Let's all move like jaguars do!” Diego crawls and they follow.
cells.cn: “我们像美洲豹那样走！”Diego 趴下爬，大家跟着学。

cells.en: “Whew, that was really, really close!” Baby Jaguar almost falls in.
cells.cn: “呼，真的好险！”小美洲豹差点掉进水里。

cells.en: “We have to jump like a jaguar to get up the mountain!”
cells.cn: “我们得像美洲豹那样跳，才能上到山顶！”

cells.en: Diego hugs Baby Bear and Baby Jaguar at the top of the mountain.
cells.cn: 在山顶上，Diego 抱住了小熊宝宝和小美洲豹。

S04E08.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Baby Jaguar's Roar”.
S04E08.ending: In the end, they all reach the top of the mountain. My favorite part is ______.

S04E09.title: A Crown for King BoBo
S04E09.hook: BoBo 国王的生日会要开始了，可他的王冠不见了，Dora 和 Boots 帮他一路找回来。

cells.en: “I always wear my crown on my head!” says King BoBo.
cells.cn: “我的王冠总是戴在头上的！”BoBo 国王说。

cells.en: “Right!” says Map. The fountain, the swing, then the garden.
cells.cn: “往右！”地图说。先过喷泉，再到秋千，最后是花园。

cells.en: They look in the castle, but the crown is not there.
cells.cn: 他们在城堡里找了一圈，可是王冠不在那儿。

cells.en: “Now do you see the garden?” The horses carry flowers on their backs.
cells.cn: “现在你看见花园了吗？”马背上驮着花，正往那边走。

cells.en: “I might have a long ladder in my backpack!” says Dora.
cells.cn: “我的背包里也许有一架长梯子！”Dora 说。

cells.en: Two paths go through the flowers: one red, one yellow.
cells.cn: 两条小路从花丛中穿过：一条红色，一条黄色。

cells.en: “That sneaky fox!” Swiper takes the crown and runs away.
cells.cn: “那只狡猾的狐狸！”Swiper 抓起王冠就跑。

cells.en: “Way to go, King Juan El Bobo!” The crown is back on his head.
cells.cn: “太棒了，Juan El Bobo 国王！”王冠又回到了他头上。

cells.en: “Gracias, Mommy!” The king hugs his family at the party.
cells.cn: “谢谢妈妈！”国王在生日会上抱住了家人。

S04E09.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “A Crown for King BoBo”.
S04E09.ending: In the end, the king gets his crown back for his birthday. My favorite part is ______.

S04E10.title: Dora Saves The Mermaids
S04E10.hook: 美人鱼 Mariana 的珍珠被海盗猪抢走，海也变脏了，Dora 和 Boots 骑海豚去救她。

cells.en: Thanks for helping us clean up the beach, little clam shell!
cells.cn: 谢谢你帮我们一起清理海滩，小贝壳！

cells.en: Boots sees a big ship far out on the water.
cells.cn: Boots 看见远处的海面上有一艘大船。

cells.en: Look at all the numbers! They go over the number bridge.
cells.cn: 看这么多数字！他们要走过数字桥。

cells.en: What number comes after five? Six, then seven.
cells.cn: 五后面是几呢？是六，再往后是七。

cells.en: Swim fast, little fish! Dora knows we can do it.
cells.cn: 小鱼快游！Dora 知道我们一定能做到。

cells.en: Three pirate pigs live in the Silly Sea.
cells.cn: 三只海盗猪住在“傻傻海”里。

cells.en: In the Silly Sea there is a fish that meows. It is a catfish!
cells.cn: 傻傻海里有会喵喵叫的鱼，是猫鱼！

cells.en: Dora and Boots ride dolphins over the blue waves.
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 骑着海豚越过蓝色浪花。

cells.en: Now Dora can wish the Mermaid Kingdom clean and bright again.
cells.cn: 现在 Dora 可以许愿让人鱼王国重新干净明亮。

S04E10.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora Saves The Mermaids”.
S04E10.ending: In the end, the sea is clean again and Mariana gets her pearl back. My favorite part is ______.

S04E11.title: Big Sister Dora
S04E11.hook: 妈妈生了一对双胞胎，Dora 要当大姐姐了，还得穿过幽灵森林赶到医院。

cells.en: Wears diapers, sleeps in a cradle... The answer is a baby!
cells.cn: 穿尿布、睡摇篮……谜底是小宝宝！

cells.en: Backpack shows shapes under the red diamond.
cells.cn: 背包里露出形状，红菱形下面还藏着东西。

cells.en: Do you see the Spooky Forest on the way?
cells.cn: 你看见路上那片“幽灵森林”了吗？

cells.en: Isa the iguana knows the way through the trees.
cells.cn: 绿鬣蜥 Isa 认得穿过树林的路。

cells.en: Everyone shouts, “A baby, a baby, a baby!”
cells.cn: 大家一起喊：“宝宝，宝宝，宝宝！”

cells.en: Which one can take them? The wheel is right.
cells.cn: 哪一个能带他们去？方向盘那个才对。

cells.en: The train needs a green flag. Can you say verde, green?
cells.cn: 火车需要一面绿旗。你能说 verde（绿色）吗？

cells.en: Map checks the path to the big hospital.
cells.cn: 地图把去医院的路打上了勾。

cells.en: Dora holds the two new babies in her arms.
cells.cn: Dora 把两个新生儿抱在怀里。

S04E11.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Big Sister Dora”.
S04E11.ending: In the end, Dora becomes a big sister to two babies. My favorite part is ______.

S04E12.title: Boots to the Rescue
S04E12.hook: Dora 写的歌被风吹跑了，Boots 一个人带上地图，穿过机器人房子把歌追回来。

cells.en: Dora is great at writing songs about her friends.
cells.cn: Dora 很会给朋友们写歌。

cells.en: Boots says, “Then we go through the robot house.”
cells.cn: Boots 说：“然后我们要穿过机器人房子。”

cells.en: Boots points up and says, “Look, it's a bird!”
cells.cn: Boots 指着上面说：“看，那是一只鸟！”

cells.en: They must find out which animals live in the jungle.
cells.cn: 他们得弄清楚丛林里住着哪些动物。

cells.en: Map checks the way, so Boots runs on fast.
cells.cn: 地图把路打了勾，Boots 就飞快地往前跑。

cells.en: In the robot house, Boots says “Abre” to open.
cells.cn: 在机器人房子里，Boots 说“Abre”来开门。

cells.en: A washing machine spins in the white laundry room.
cells.cn: 白色的洗衣房里，一台洗衣机在转。

cells.en: Boots slides down and shouts, “Whee! This is fun!”
cells.cn: Boots 滑下来喊：“哇！这真好玩！”

cells.en: Dora sings for La Maestra with a big smile.
cells.cn: Dora 笑着唱给音乐老师听。

S04E12.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Boots to the Rescue”.
S04E12.ending: In the end, Boots brings the song back and Dora sings it for La Maestra. My favorite part is ______.

S04E13.title: Super Babies
S04E13.hook: 双胞胎宝宝会飞！Swiper 偷走香蕉，超级宝宝一路吹气、搭台阶追到香蕉山。

cells.en: Dora helps her mom with the twins in the nursery.
cells.cn: Dora 在婴儿房帮妈妈照看双胞胎。

cells.en: Map shows a big mountain made of yellow bananas.
cells.cn: 地图上是一座用黄香蕉堆成的大山。

cells.en: Yum, yum, yum! The babies eat their snack happily.
cells.cn: 好吃好吃！宝宝们开心地吃着点心。

cells.en: The babies blow air into the boat for them.
cells.cn: 宝宝们往船里吹气，把船吹起来。

cells.en: Dora wears a yellow raincoat and holds a paddle.
cells.cn: Dora 穿着黄色雨衣，手里拿着桨。

cells.en: The babies fly high in their little baby carriage.
cells.cn: 宝宝们坐在小推车里飞得高高的。

cells.en: They build the steps with many color blocks.
cells.cn: 他们用好多彩色积木搭出台阶。

cells.en: Dora and Boots ride along with the babies.
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 带着宝宝们一起坐车。

cells.en: Swiper wants the bananas, but the babies fly up.
cells.cn: Swiper 想要香蕉，可宝宝们飞了起来。

S04E13.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Super Babies”.
S04E13.ending: In the end, the super babies save the bananas from Swiper. My favorite part is ______.

S04E14.title: We're a Team
S04E14.hook: Dora 和朋友们组队去火山比赛，章鱼 Val 举着计时器，谁都得靠大家一起过关。

cells.en: Dora and her friends are a team for the big race.
cells.cn: Dora 和朋友们组成一队，参加一场大比赛。

cells.en: Val the octopus starts the clock at twenty minutes.
cells.cn: 章鱼 Val 把计时器定在二十分钟。

cells.en: Backpack has a horn, a rope, a ball and a bottle.
cells.cn: 背包里有喇叭、绳子、皮球和水壶。

cells.en: The team runs past the wood steps in the jungle.
cells.cn: 队伍跑过丛林里的木头台阶。

cells.en: Everyone works together to reach the volcano.
cells.cn: 大家齐心协力往火山前进。

cells.en: They hide in the bushes and say, “De nada.”
cells.cn: 他们躲在灌木丛里说：“不客气。”

cells.en: And together, they all get over the high wall.
cells.cn: 于是一起，他们全都翻过了高墙。

cells.en: The clock shows three seconds left for the team.
cells.cn: 计时器显示队伍只剩三秒钟。

cells.en: Now every friend has a gold medal around the neck.
cells.cn: 现在每个朋友脖子上都挂着一块金牌。

S04E14.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “We're a Team”.
S04E14.ending: In the end, the whole team finishes the race and wins medals. My favorite part is ______.

S04E15.title: The Mixed-Up Seasons
S04E15.hook: 夏天沙滩上冒出一个雪人，四个季节全跑错了地方。

cells.en: “I love, love, love the summer!” Boots plays on the hot sand.
cells.cn: “我最爱、最爱夏天啦！”Boots 在热乎乎的沙滩上又蹦又跳。

cells.en: A big snowman stands on the beach. “Right, Dora?” says Boots.
cells.cn: 沙滩上站着一个大雪人，Boots 问：“对不对，Dora？”

cells.en: “A balloon can take us there!” The big balloon waits on the sand.
cells.cn: “热气球能带我们去那儿！”大大的热气球就停在沙滩上。

cells.en: Dora and Boots slide down the snowy mountain on a sled.
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 坐着雪橇，从雪山上一路滑下来。

cells.en: Boots holds a big flower. “I live in a flower patch.”
cells.cn: Boots 抱着一朵大花，花儿说：“我住在花圃里。”

cells.en: They meet a pumpkin. “We need to find fall,” says Dora.
cells.cn: 他们遇到一个南瓜，Dora 说：“我们得去找秋天。”

cells.en: A wind cloud blows the pumpkin cart. The red leaves fly away.
cells.cn: 风云吹起了南瓜小车，红叶漫天飞。

cells.en: “Muchas gracias!” The sand crabs are home on the warm beach.
cells.cn: “非常感谢！”沙蟹们回到了暖暖的沙滩老家。

cells.en: “What's your favorite season?” Dora sees winter, spring, summer and fall.
cells.cn: “你最喜欢哪个季节？”Dora 眼前有冬天、春天、夏天和秋天。

S04E15.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Mixed-Up Seasons”.
S04E15.ending: In the end, every season goes back to its own place. My favorite part is ______.

S04E16.title: The Shy Rainbow
S04E16.hook: 彩虹太害羞，一直躲着不肯出来，Dora 得帮它把颜色一块块找回来。

cells.en: A shy rainbow hides behind the yellow hill today.
cells.cn: 今天，一道害羞的彩虹躲在黄色小山后面。

cells.en: The rainbow says, “I need you to come right away.”
cells.cn: 彩虹说：“我需要你马上过来一趟。”

cells.en: Arco Iris, you knew the answer! The rainbow shows the way.
cells.cn: 彩虹 Arco Iris 你知道答案！彩虹指出了路。

cells.en: The bridge has red, blue and green color boards.
cells.cn: 这座桥上的木板有红、蓝、绿三种颜色。

cells.en: Look, there are three paths in three colors.
cells.cn: 瞧，有三条颜色各不相同的小路。

cells.en: The red boat is missing some of its color.
cells.cn: 红色小船上少了一些颜色。

cells.en: What do we do if we run into any sneezing snakes ahead?
cells.cn: 要是路上遇到打喷嚏的蛇，我们该怎么办？

cells.en: Dora points at the green leaf and says “¡Verde!”
cells.cn: Dora 指着绿叶说：“绿色！”

cells.en: The rainbow stretches wide and smiles at everyone.
cells.cn: 彩虹舒展开来，对大家笑。

S04E16.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Shy Rainbow”.
S04E16.ending: In the end, the shy rainbow comes out and shows all its colors. My favorite part is ______.

S04E17.title: Baby Crab
S04E17.hook: 小螃蟹被渔网缠住了，Dora 帮它找妈妈，一路走过沙堡和满是贝壳的沙滩。

cells.en: Dora gets the baby crab out of the fishing net.
cells.cn: Dora 把小螃蟹从渔网里救了出来。

cells.en: They shake their bodies and sing “Menea te”.
cells.cn: 他们一边扭扭身子，一边唱“动起来”。

cells.en: Map says: castle, clams, then Crab Island.
cells.cn: 地图说：沙堡、蛤蜊，然后到螃蟹岛。

cells.en: The little crab snaps its claws on the sand.
cells.cn: 小螃蟹在沙地上“咔哒咔哒”地夹钳子。

cells.en: Dora steps in the wet sand. “That was squishy!”
cells.cn: Dora 踩进湿沙子，“软软的，好奇怪！”

cells.en: They walk past many sandcastles on the beach.
cells.cn: 他们走过沙滩上一座座沙堡。

cells.en: There are shells, stars and crabs on the sand.
cells.cn: 沙滩上有贝壳、海星，还有螃蟹。

cells.en: Map says, “Crab Island, right!” and checks the way.
cells.cn: 地图说：“螃蟹岛，对啦！”然后把路打勾。

cells.en: The baby crab gives mommy a pearl necklace.
cells.cn: 小螃蟹送给妈妈一串珍珠项链。

S04E17.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Baby Crab”.
S04E17.ending: In the end, the baby crab finds its mommy on Crab Island. My favorite part is ______.

S04E18.title: Swiper the Explorer
S04E18.hook: Swiper 捡到一只走丢的小狐狸，这回他当起探险家，要和 Dora 一起送它回家。

cells.en: Dora and Boots find a baby fox near the bushes.
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 在灌木丛边发现一只小狐狸。

cells.en: Map says the baby fox lives far from here.
cells.cn: 地图说，小狐狸的家离这儿很远。

cells.en: Swiper carries the baby fox in his two arms.
cells.cn: Swiper 用两条胳膊抱着小狐狸。

cells.en: They ask for something for the baby fox to drink.
cells.cn: 他们想问谁有小狐狸能喝的东西。

cells.en: Swiper picks an orange near the big volcano ground.
cells.cn: Swiper 在火山旁边的地上摘了一个橙子。

cells.en: The baby fox drinks and smiles at Swiper.
cells.cn: 小狐狸喝完了，冲 Swiper 笑。

cells.en: Diego comes and helps them find wild animals.
cells.cn: Diego 赶来，帮他们找丛林里的野生动物。

cells.en: The baby fox gets away from the chasey bats.
cells.cn: 小狐狸甩掉了追着它的蝙蝠。

cells.en: Mama fox says, “Mi zorrito, you came back!”
cells.cn: 狐狸妈妈说：“我的小狐狸，你回来啦！”

S04E18.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Swiper the Explorer”.
S04E18.ending: In the end, Swiper brings the baby fox back to its mama. My favorite part is ______.

S04E19.title: Catch the Babies
S04E19.hook: 双胞胎宝宝一出门就到处乱爬，全家总动员追着他们去农场、花园和黏黏泉。

cells.en: Dora's whole family is in the living room together.
cells.cn: Dora 一家人全都在客厅里。

cells.en: Map shows the way: farm, garden, gooey geyser.
cells.cn: 地图指路：农场、花园，再到黏黏泉。

cells.en: Farm, garden, Gooey Geyser! They say the map words together.
cells.cn: 农场、花园、黏糊糊间歇泉！他们一起念地图上的三个地方。

cells.en: There are big watermelons in the wooden box.
cells.cn: 木箱子里装着大西瓜。

cells.en: Farm, garden, Gooey Geyser! They say the map words together.
cells.cn: 农场、花园、间歇泉！他们一起把地图上的地名念了一遍。

cells.en: Three purple flowers smile and sing in the garden.
cells.cn: 花园里三朵紫色的花笑着唱歌。

cells.en: Run! The Gooey Geyser is right behind them. Corre, corre!
cells.cn: 快跑！黏糊糊间歇泉就在他们身后。

cells.en: They push through the green leaves and shout, “Louder!”
cells.cn: 他们钻过绿叶，大声喊：“再大声点！”

cells.en: The babies love bubbles! Everyone is happy and safe now.
cells.cn: 宝宝们喜欢泡泡！现在大家都平安开心。

S04E19.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Catch the Babies”.
S04E19.ending: In the end, the family catches the babies and the geyser sprays bubbles. My favorite part is ______.

S04E20.title: Dora and Diego to the Rescue!
S04E20.titleCn: Dora 和 Diego 出发救援
S04E20.hook: Boots 被风刮到海上飞了起来，Dora 叫上 Diego，一路追到北极熊山。

cells.en: Dora and Diego look for a monkey near the bushes.
cells.cn: Dora 和 Diego 在灌木丛附近找一只小猴子。

cells.en: Map says Boots is flying to Polar Bear Mountain.
cells.cn: 地图说 Boots 正飞向北极熊山。

cells.en: Dora is flying over the ocean on the big birds.
cells.cn: Dora 骑在大鸟上飞越大大洋。

cells.en: Dora stands on the rocks and says, “I need help.”
cells.cn: Dora 站在岩石上说：“我需要帮忙。”

cells.en: Two paths go up the hill. Which one is right?
cells.cn: 两条小路通向山上，哪一条才对？

cells.en: Diego says, “Put your hands out in front of you.”
cells.cn: Diego 说：“把双手伸到身前。”

cells.en: Tall grass hides elephants, zebras and a giraffe.
cells.cn: 高高的草丛里藏着大象、斑马和长颈鹿。

cells.en: The lion mom says, “Thanks for finding my baby.”
cells.cn: 狮子妈妈说：“谢谢你找到我的宝宝。”

cells.en: Dora and Diego shout, we are coming, Boots, hold on!
cells.cn: Dora 和 Diego 喊道：Boots 坚持住，我们来了！

S04E20.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora and Diego to the Rescue!”.
S04E20.ending: In the end, Dora and Diego save Boots at Polar Bear Mountain. My favorite part is ______.

S04E21.title: Dora's Fairytale Adventure
S04E21.hook: Dora 走进童话王国，七个矮人、巨人和绿龙都来帮忙，她还要找到城堡里的王子。

cells.en: Calling all Cinderellas! You are welcome in Fairy Tale Land.
cells.cn: 各位灰姑娘听好！欢迎来到童话之地。

cells.en: Dora wears her backpack and walks into the story.
cells.cn: Dora 背着书包，走进了故事里。

cells.en: I was under a spell for a long time, the lion says sadly.
cells.cn: 狮子伤心地说：我被魔咒困了好久好久。

cells.en: The giant sings, “Fee-fi-fo-fum, fumpty-dumpty-dum!”
cells.cn: 巨人唱着：“ fee-fi-fo-fum，咚咚咚！”

cells.en: They teach the big rocks how to sing a song.
cells.cn: 他们教大石头唱歌。

cells.en: The giant gives them a bag of warm sunshine.
cells.cn: 巨人送给他们一袋暖烘烘的阳光。

cells.en: Map shows the way to the castle far away.
cells.cn: 地图指出通往远方城堡的路。

cells.en: Long hair grows down to the floor of the room.
cells.cn: 长长的头发一直垂到房间的地板上。

cells.en: Viva Tico! The friends cheer for the brave little squirrel.
cells.cn: Tico 万岁！伙伴们为勇敢的小松鼠欢呼。

S04E21.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora's Fairytale Adventure”.
S04E21.ending: In the end, Dora wakes up from the fairy tale spell in the castle. My favorite part is ______.

S05E01.title: The Backpack Parade
S05E01.hook: Backpack 要在游行上唱开场歌，可她一路打喷嚏，背里的东西全飞了出去。

cells.en: Backpack says, “The parade can't start without my song.”
cells.cn: Backpack 说：“没有我的歌，游行就没法开始。”

cells.en: Dora, Boots and Backpack walk down the long path together.
cells.cn: Dora、Boots 和 Backpack 一起沿着长长的小路往前走。

cells.en: “Correct, a square!” The bridge is fixed, so they can cross.
cells.cn: “答对了，是正方形！”桥修好了，他们能过河了。

cells.en: “Achoo!” Backpack sneezes and her things fly up in the air.
cells.cn: “啊嚏！”Backpack 打了个大喷嚏，她的东西全飞了起来。

cells.en: Her sticky tape, books and ruler lie on the green grass.
cells.cn: 她的胶带、书本和尺子都掉在绿草地上了。

cells.en: “Hey, they're not waking up.” The trees with faces sleep.
cells.cn: “嘿，怎么叫都叫不醒。”长着脸的树全在睡觉。

cells.en: “That sneaky fox is always trying to swipe our stuff.”
cells.cn: “那只狡猾的狐狸总想偷我们的东西。”

cells.en: “Thank you, thank you.” Now Swiper has a backpack for the parade.
cells.cn: “谢谢，谢谢！”现在 Swiper 也有参加游行的背包了。

cells.en: “Time to sing!” Dora lifts Backpack up at the parade.
cells.cn: “到唱歌的时间啦！”Dora 在游行上把 Backpack 高高举起。

S05E01.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Backpack Parade”.
S05E01.ending: In the end, Backpack sings at the parade and Swiper gets a backpack too. My favorite part is ______.

S05E02.title: Benny's Big Race
S05E02.hook: Benny 邀请 Dora 和 Boots 参加大赛车，他们要颠过路障锥、穿过沙漠，还要救出卡在洞里的小车手。

cells.en: Benny the bull invites us to watch his big race today.
cells.cn: Benny 这头公牛邀请我们来看他今天的大赛车。

cells.en: They put two large wheels at the back of the red kart.
cells.cn: 他们在红色赛车的后面装上两个大轮子。

cells.en: Map says: first the cones, then the desert, then the finish line.
cells.cn: 地图说：先过路障锥，再穿沙漠，最后到终点线。

cells.en: One racer stops right in the middle of the road.
cells.cn: 一位选手把车停在路中间，挡住了大家。

cells.en: “Bounce in your seats!” They bump over the cones and laugh.
cells.cn: “在座位上弹一弹！”他们颠过路障锥，笑个不停。

cells.en: “Can you say con permiso?” Dora asks with a big smile.
cells.cn: Dora 笑着问：“你会说 con permiso 吗？”（意思是“借过一下”）

cells.en: “Maybe she can help us find water,” says Boots in the desert.
cells.cn: “也许她能帮我们找到水，”Boots 在沙漠里说。

cells.en: “My go-kart is stuck in a hole!” the little driver shouts.
cells.cn: “我的赛车卡在洞里出不来啦！”小车手大声喊。

cells.en: “He did it, hooray!” The big red chicken lifts the gold cup.
cells.cn: “他做到了，好棒！”大红鸡在终点举起了金杯。

S05E02.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Benny's Big Race”.
S05E02.ending: In the end, they reach the finish line and the big red chicken lifts the gold cup. My favorite part is ______.

S05E03.title: Isa's Unicorn Flowers
S05E03.hook: 独角兽的角上会开满小花，可是它想让妈妈也有花，于是 Dora 和 Isa 陪它一路去找白锥子，还得先让拦路的红龙让开。

cells.en: Dora and Isa are in the garden, and Isa says, “Great!”
cells.cn: Dora 和 Isa 在花园里，Isa 说：“太棒了！”

cells.en: A white unicorn asks, “Would you like some flowers for your mommy?”
cells.cn: 一只白色独角兽问：“你想带些花回去送给妈妈吗？”

cells.en: Map shows three jars: one flower, one umbrella, one candy cane.
cells.cn: 地图上画着三个罐子：一朵花、一把雨伞、一根拐杖糖。

cells.en: “If we all dragon dance, he'll get out of the way!” says Dora.
cells.cn: “我们一起跳龙舞，他就会让开！”Dora 说。

cells.en: The red dragons dance away, and everyone cheers, “Yay!”
cells.cn: 红龙们跳着走开了，大家一起欢呼：“耶！”

cells.en: “So we need to look for white cones,” Dora tells the unicorn.
cells.cn: “所以我们要去找白色的锥子。”Dora 对独角兽说。

cells.en: “Oh, I love purple flowers!” Dora and Isa stand by the gate.
cells.cn: “噢，我喜欢紫色的花！”Dora 和 Isa 站在大门边。

cells.en: “Ooh, unicorn flowers!” Dora sees flowers near the unicorn's horn.
cells.cn: “哇，独角兽花！”Dora 看见独角兽角边上开满了花。

cells.en: Now all the unicorns have flowers, and they sing, “We did it!”
cells.cn: 现在所有独角兽都有花了，它们一起唱：“我们做到了！”

S05E03.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Isa's Unicorn Flowers”.
S05E03.ending: In the end, the unicorns give flowers to their mommy and everyone is happy. My favorite part is ______.

S05E04.title: Dora's Jack-in-the-Box
S05E04.hook: 为了哄哭闹的双胞胎弟妹，Dora 和 Boots 带着玩偶盒去找玩具，要先找到娃娃、再唱开钢琴大门才到家。

cells.en: Dora and Boots are at the toy store, and they say, “We do too!”
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 在玩具店里，他们说：“我们也一样！”

cells.en: “Help me wind the crank to play Jack's song,” says Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“帮我转动摇柄，放 Jack 的歌吧。”

cells.en: Map says the way is the doll, the gate, then Dora's house.
cells.cn: 地图说路线是：娃娃、大门，最后到 Dora 家。

cells.en: “Yay, we stopped Swiper!” Dora and Boots cheer in the forest.
cells.cn: “太好啦，我们拦住了 Swiper！”Dora 和 Boots 在森林里欢呼。

cells.en: There are five dolls here, and the biggest doll holds smaller ones.
cells.cn: 这里一共有五个娃娃，最大的那个里面装着小娃娃。

cells.en: Tico drives his red car, and Dora and Boots ride in the back.
cells.cn: Tico 开着红色小车，Dora 和 Boots 坐在后面。

cells.en: “Un hoyo! Cuidado!” They see a big hole in the road.
cells.cn: “Un hoyo（一个洞）！小心！”他们看见路上有个大洞。

cells.en: They sing Old MacDonald at the giant piano gate to open it.
cells.cn: 他们在巨大的钢琴门前唱《Old MacDonald》，门才会打开。

cells.en: Jack pops out of the box, and the baby twins laugh at last.
cells.cn: Jack 从盒子里弹出来，双胞胎宝宝终于笑了。

S05E04.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora's Jack-in-the-Box”.
S05E04.ending: In the end, Jack pops out and the baby twins laugh and feel better. My favorite part is ______.

S05E05.title: Dora Saves the Snow Princess
S05E05.hook: 雪森林正在融化，雪公主被雪女巫施了魔法，Dora 和 Boots 要坐船、滑过雪山，才能把魔法还给真正该拥有它的人。

cells.en: The snowy forest is melting, and the trees look dry and sad.
cells.cn: 雪森林正在融化，树木干巴巴的，看起来很伤心。

cells.en: “To be the Snow Princess, that's you,” says the snowflake fairy.
cells.cn: “要当雪公主的人，就是你。”雪花仙子说。

cells.en: “Boots: a witch!” A witch flies over the trees on her broom.
cells.cn: “Boots：一个女巫！”一个女巫骑着扫帚飞过树梢。

cells.en: “So remember...” Map shows the snowy path they must take.
cells.cn: “所以要记住……”地图上画出了他们要走的雪路。

cells.en: “Can you say ‘más despacio’?” Dora asks in her warm coat.
cells.cn: “你会说‘más despacio（慢一点）’吗？”Dora 穿着厚外套问。

cells.en: On the ship they sing about the icy sea snake in the water.
cells.cn: 他们在船上唱起了水里的冰海蛇。

cells.en: Backpack shows a sled and many things to slide down the mountain.
cells.cn: Backpack 拿出了雪橇和一堆东西，好让他们滑下雪山。

cells.en: “The witch cast a spell on me,” the Snow Princess tells Dora.
cells.cn: “女巫对我施了魔法。”雪公主对 Dora 说。

cells.en: “To someone who's proven they can use it for good things.”
cells.cn: “给一个证明过自己会用魔法做好事的人。”

S05E05.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora Saves the Snow Princess”.
S05E05.ending: In the end, the snow comes back to the forest and the Snow Princess is free. My favorite part is ______.

S05E06.title: The Mayan Adventure
S05E06.hook: Hoon 和 Balan 两兄弟进不了球赛，Dora 得先找到月亮碎片，打开金字塔里那扇门。

cells.en: Hoon and Balan cannot play in the championship today.
cells.cn: Hoon 和 Balan 今天不能参加球赛了。

cells.en: Map says, “First you go to the pyramid.”
cells.cn: 地图说：“先到金字塔去。”

cells.en: “To open the door, we need the pieces of the moon.”
cells.cn: “要打开这扇门，我们得找到月亮的碎片。”

cells.en: There are steps to go up and a slide to go down.
cells.cn: 这里有上去的台阶，也有滑下去的滑梯。

cells.en: “We don't want to run into the snakes,” says Dora.
cells.cn: “我们可不想撞上那些蛇。”Dora 说。

cells.en: And look how much brighter the constellations are.
cells.cn: 看，天上的星座一下子亮多了。

cells.en: “We're going to the ball game!” everyone sings.
cells.cn: 大家一起唱：“我们要去看球赛啦！”

cells.en: The pink monkey bumps the ball back to Dora.
cells.cn: 粉色小猴子把球顶回给 Dora。

cells.en: “And then the game is more fun to play,” says Hoon.
cells.cn: “这样球赛就更好玩了。”Hoon 说。

S05E06.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Mayan Adventure”.
S05E06.ending: In the end, Hoon and Balan play in the ball game. My favorite part is ______.

S05E07.title: Bouncy Boots
S05E07.hook: Boots 的靴子不见了，他要一路跳过大门口、过小河，去鞋店里一双一双地找，才能找回自己的靴子。

cells.en: “I can't wait to get my boots back, Dora,” says Boots.
cells.cn: “我迫不及待想拿回我的靴子了，Dora。”Boots 说。

cells.en: “Right, son diferentes.” These red boots are not his.
cells.cn: “对，它们不一样（son diferentes）。”这双红靴子不是他的。

cells.en: Dora's cards show the gates, the river and the shoe shop.
cells.cn: Dora 的卡片上是：大门、小河，还有鞋店。

cells.en: Boots bounces down the path and sings, “Boing, boing, boing!”
cells.cn: Boots 沿着小路一蹦一跳，唱着“Boing, boing, boing！”

cells.en: “I'll have to jump really, really high to reach the key.”
cells.cn: “我得跳得高高的，才能拿到那把钥匙。”

cells.en: “I'm gonna have to jump really, really, really high!” says Boots.
cells.cn: “这次我得跳得超级超级高！”Boots 说。

cells.en: “If the nuts are up or if the nuts are down?” Dora asks Tico.
cells.cn: “果子在上面，还是在下面？”Dora 问 Tico。

cells.en: “Are they Boots' boots?” Dora looks at the boots on the shelf.
cells.cn: “这是 Boots 的靴子吗？”Dora 看着货架上的靴子。

cells.en: At last Boots has his boots, and everyone smiles at the shop.
cells.cn: 最后 Boots 拿回了自己的靴子，大家在鞋店门口都笑了。

S05E07.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Bouncy Boots”.
S05E07.ending: In the end, Boots gets his bouncy boots back and bounces all the way home. My favorite part is ______.

S05E08.title: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Show
S05E08.hook: 魔术秀开始了，可大红鸡被卡在小山里出不来，Dora 和 Boots 要穿过城堡和森林，学会咒语才能帮它。

cells.en: Dora and Boots are at the magic show with two little mice.
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 来看魔术秀，台上还有两只小老鼠。

cells.en: “The bunny must have gone back to Magic Land,” says Boots.
cells.cn: “小兔子一定是回魔法世界去了。”Boots 说。

cells.en: Dora's cards show a castle, a forest and a bunny hill.
cells.cn: Dora 的卡片上是城堡、森林，还有兔子山。

cells.en: “Comencemos!” The Queen of Hearts holds up her cards.
cells.cn: “我们开始吧（comencemos）！”红心王后举起了她的牌。

cells.en: “One, we need one more heart,” Dora and Boots count.
cells.cn: “一个，还差一个红心。”Dora 和 Boots 一起数着。

cells.en: “Abracadabra!” The white dove flies up from the log.
cells.cn: “Abracadabra（变）！”白鸽子从木头上飞了起来。

cells.en: “Can you say ‘abre, puerta’?” Dora asks at the blue door.
cells.cn: “你会说‘abre, puerta（开门）’吗？”Dora 在蓝色小门前问。

cells.en: “I need your help to get out of the hill!” says the chicken.
cells.cn: “我需要你们帮忙，我才能从山里出来！”大红鸡说。

cells.en: “Whoo!” The Big Red Chicken is big again at the show.
cells.cn: “呼！”大红鸡在舞台上又变大了。

S05E08.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Big Red Chicken's Magic Show”.
S05E08.ending: In the end, the Big Red Chicken gets out of the hill and is big again. My favorite part is ______.

S05E09.title: Benny's Treasure
S05E09.hook: 今天是废品日，Benny 捡了满满一车旧东西要送去废品场，路上得先学会巨怪的声音，再折一只纸天鹅过湖。

cells.en: Benny's wagon is full of the stuff people throw away.
cells.cn: Benny 的小车里装满了人们扔掉的旧东西。

cells.en: Map says, “First the bridge, then across Swan Lake.”
cells.cn: 地图说：“先过桥，再穿过天鹅湖。”

cells.en: “We need to match the sounds that the troll makes,” says Dora.
cells.cn: “我们要模仿巨怪发出的声音。”Dora 说。

cells.en: “Yeah, that alarm clock!” The troll's bell sounds just like it.
cells.cn: “对，就是那个闹钟！”巨怪的铃铛声跟它一模一样。

cells.en: “Thanks, Mr. Troll!” They walk across the bridge with the wagon.
cells.cn: “谢谢，巨怪先生！”他们推着车走过了桥。

cells.en: Benny puts a big silver bowl on his head and looks funny.
cells.cn: Benny 把一个大银碗扣在头上，看起来很好笑。

cells.en: “Yeah, I have all sorts of paper,” says Isa on the sand.
cells.cn: “有啊，我有各种各样的纸。”Isa 在沙滩上说。

cells.en: “It can fly?” Benny and Dora ride on a big paper swan.
cells.cn: “它会飞吗？”Benny 和 Dora 坐上了一只大纸天鹅。

cells.en: At the junkyard, the big crane lifts Benny's heavy wagon.
cells.cn: 在废品场，大吊车把 Benny 沉重的车吊了起来。

S05E09.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Benny's Treasure”.
S05E09.ending: In the end, the crane lifts Benny's wagon and all the junk goes to the junkyard. My favorite part is ______.

S05E10.title: Dora Saves Three Kings Day
S05E10.hook: 三位国王的动物要在天黑前送到派对，朵拉和伙伴们分头去找。

cells.en: Dora, Boots and Diego dress up like kings at the Rescue Center.
cells.cn: 朵拉、布茨和迪亚哥在动物救助中心扮成国王。

cells.en: Diego says the three kings ride their animals to the party.
cells.cn: 迪亚哥说，三位国王要骑着动物去参加派对。

cells.en: “El caballo is the horse,” says Dora. “I take this one.”
cells.cn: “El caballo 就是马，”朵拉说，“我就要这一匹。”

cells.en: Diego sings that they must find all the animals today.
cells.cn: 迪亚哥唱着说，今天一定要把所有动物都找到。

cells.en: They find the elephant, and the elephant brings the golden rings.
cells.cn: 他们找到了大象，大象背上驮着金戒指。

cells.en: It is hard to find the camel in the dark desert.
cells.cn: 天黑了，在沙漠里找那匹骆驼真不容易。

cells.en: “Can I ride him now, Diego?” asks Boots with a smile.
cells.cn: “我现在能骑他了吗，迪亚哥？”布茨笑着问。

cells.en: The white horse runs fast, and the children laugh and cheer.
cells.cn: 白马跑得飞快，孩子们笑着欢呼。

cells.en: At last they get to the party. ¡Felicidades! Everyone is happy.
cells.cn: 他们终于赶到了派对。¡Felicidades！大家都很开心。

S05E10.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora Saves Three Kings Day”.
S05E10.ending: In the end, Dora and her friends bring all the animals to the Three Kings Day party. My favorite part is ______.

S05E11.title: Dora Saves the Three Little Piggies
S05E11.hook: 故事书里的大灰狼吹倒了小猪的砖房，Dora 和 Boots 要进故事里帮小猪运砖修房子。

cells.en: The big wolf says, “I can't blow the piggies' bricks down.”
cells.cn: 大灰狼说：“我吹不倒小猪们的砖房。”

cells.en: “Bring the bricks back to the three little piggies,” says Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“把砖块运回去，送给三只小猪。”

cells.en: The story map shows a straw mountain and a maze of sticks.
cells.cn: 故事书的地图上画着草山和树枝迷宫。

cells.en: The bricks are too heavy to roll up the straw mountain.
cells.cn: 砖块太重了，推不上草山。

cells.en: “Say ‘mucho más grande!’” The boy wants a bigger balloon.
cells.cn: “说‘再大一点！’”小男孩想要一个更大的气球。

cells.en: “Cinderella's slipper is up in the tree,” says Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“灰姑娘的水晶鞋挂在树上呢。”

cells.en: “We come to fix your house of bricks,” Dora tells the piggies.
cells.cn: Dora 对小猪们说：“我们来帮你们修砖房啦。”

cells.en: “He's starting to huff and puff!” The wolf blows at the wall.
cells.cn: “他开始呼呼地吹气了！”大灰狼对着墙猛吹。

cells.en: “Aw, piggy kisses!” The three little piggies are safe now.
cells.cn: “哎呀，小猪的亲亲！”三只小猪现在安全了。

S05E11.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora Saves the Three Little Piggies”.
S05E11.ending: In the end, the three little piggies live in a strong brick house. My favorite part is ______.

S05E12.title: Bark, Bark to Play Park
S05E12.hook: 双胞胎节到了，Perrito 的孪生兄弟不见了，他们穿过会说话的狗屋、翻过双峰山，去游乐场找它。

cells.en: Here are Perrito and his twin as little puppies.
cells.cn: 照片里是 Perrito 和他的双胞胎兄弟小时候的样子。

cells.en: “The doghouse, right!” Dora points at the first stop on the map.
cells.cn: “对，是狗屋！”Dora 指着路线图上的第一站。

cells.en: Boots says, “Computer, open the door!” The doghouse door opens.
cells.cn: Boots 说：“电脑，开门！”狗屋的门就打开了。

cells.en: “We made it through the doghouse, check!” Dora looks at her three cards.
cells.cn: “我们穿过狗屋啦，打勾！”Dora 看着手里的三张路线卡。

cells.en: “Where is the snow on the other mountain?” The two mountains look alike.
cells.cn: “另一座山上的雪去哪儿了？”两座山长得一模一样。

cells.en: The boy says, “These handles help us climb up the rocks.”
cells.cn: 小男孩说：“这些把手能帮我们爬上岩石。”

cells.en: Dora asks, “¿Dónde está la fiesta?” They look for the party.
cells.cn: Dora 问：“庆典在哪儿呀？”他们到处找派对。

cells.en: “Do you see his twin?” The park is full of trucks and swings.
cells.cn: “你看到他的双胞胎兄弟了吗？”公园里满是秋千和小卡车。

cells.en: They find out Swiper's puppy is Perrito's twin brother.
cells.cn: 他们发现，Swiper 的小狗就是 Perrito 的双胞胎兄弟。

S05E12.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Bark, Bark to Play Park”.
S05E12.ending: In the end, they find out Swiper's puppy is Perrito's twin brother, and all the puppies go to the Twins Day party. My favorite part is ______.

S05E13.title: Dora Saves the Crystal Kingdom
S05E13.hook: 故事书里的蓝水晶碎了，水晶王国的颜色正在一点点消失，Dora 和 Boots 要跳进书里，找齐四颗水晶才能把颜色还回来。

cells.en: The blue crystal made the sky and the ocean blue.
cells.cn: 蓝水晶让天空和海洋都变成了蓝色。

cells.en: “But the king was so greedy, he didn't care,” says Dora.
cells.cn: “可是国王太贪心了，他根本不在乎。”Dora 说。

cells.en: Map shows the red crystal is still inside the Crystal Kingdom story.
cells.cn: 地图显示，红水晶还在水晶王国的故事里。

cells.en: A knight in silver armor holds a sword and a shield.
cells.cn: 一个穿银色盔甲的骑士，手拿长剑和盾牌。

cells.en: “We need to get three more crystals,” Dora tells the princess.
cells.cn: “我们还需要找三颗水晶。”Dora 对公主说。

cells.en: “When you see the butterfly that can't be seen,” the princess says.
cells.cn: “当你看见那只看不见的蝴蝶时……”公主说。

cells.en: “You can only find the crystal blue,” the princess tells them.
cells.cn: “只有这样才找得到蓝色水晶。”公主告诉他们。

cells.en: The magician lifts his wand over a big black magic hat.
cells.cn: 魔术师把魔杖举在一个黑色大礼帽上方。

cells.en: “Flap, flap, flap!” They fly up to the tall grey mountain.
cells.cn: “啪嗒、啪嗒、啪嗒！”他们飞向高高的灰色山。

S05E13.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora Saves the Crystal Kingdom”.
S05E13.ending: In the end, they find all the crystals and the colors come back to the Crystal Kingdom. My favorite part is ______.

S05E14.title: Dora's Christmas Carol Adventure (1 hour)
S05E14.hook: Swiper 上了淘气名单，只有把偷走的东西还回去才能下名单。Dora 陪他回到过去的圣诞节，一样一样把节日还给大家。

cells.en: Santa and his elves sing together at the North Pole.
cells.cn: 圣诞老人和小精灵们在北极一起唱歌。

cells.en: “La lista de los que se portaron mal” means the naughty list.
cells.cn: “La lista de los que se portaron mal”就是淘气名单。

cells.en: “The Grumpy Old Troll can help?” Dora asks Swiper in the snow.
cells.cn: “暴躁老巨怪能帮忙吗？”Dora 在雪地里问 Swiper。

cells.t: A Friend in a Santa Hat
cells.en: Their yellow friend wears a Santa hat and waves by the bridge.
cells.cn: 他们的黄色朋友戴着圣诞帽，在桥边挥手。

cells.en: “What baby is this?” A little baby sits in a red carrier.
cells.cn: “这是哪个宝宝？”一个小宝宝坐在红色提篮里。

cells.en: “Yes, Swiper, but you always swiped on Christmas,” they sing.
cells.cn: “是啊 Swiper，可你每年圣诞节都要偷东西。”他们唱道。

cells.en: “Good remembering!” Dora and her friends walk the snowy path.
cells.cn: “记性真好！”Dora 和朋友们走在雪路上。

cells.en: An old Swiper sits in a big chair and looks at the door.
cells.cn: 老 Swiper 坐在大椅子上，望着门口。

cells.en: “But, Dora, I really want to give you a Christmas present.”
cells.cn: “可是 Dora，我真的很想送你一份圣诞礼物。”

S05E14.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora's Christmas Carol Adventure”.
S05E14.ending: In the end, Swiper gives Dora a Christmas present and gets off the naughty list. My favorite part is ______.

S05E15.title: Super Babies' Dream Adventure
S05E15.titleCn: 超级宝宝的梦境大冒险
S05E15.hook: 梦幻仙子睡着了，超级宝宝要飞到她的城堡把她叫醒，一路还得修好破毯子、学公鸡打鸣。

cells.en: “Do you want to hear the Super Babies story?” Dora asks.
cells.cn: “你想听超级宝宝的故事吗？”Dora 问。

cells.en: The Dream Fairy waves her wand and says, “Dulces sueños.”
cells.cn: 梦幻仙子挥动魔杖，说：“Dulces sueños（好梦）。”

cells.en: “Where do we go first?” Dora shows the forest, mountain and castle.
cells.cn: “我们先去哪儿？”Dora 举起森林、高山和城堡的卡片。

cells.en: The Super Babies ride their stroller and sing, “Super Babies!”
cells.cn: 超级宝宝坐着小推车出发，唱着“Super Babies！”

cells.en: A big whirlwind lifts one baby high up in the forest.
cells.cn: 一阵大旋风把一个小宝宝卷到了森林上空。

cells.en: Two babies sit on the big mountain and look all around.
cells.cn: 两个宝宝坐在大山上四处张望。

cells.en: “Azul, azul, rojo!” The blanket has a red and blue pattern.
cells.cn: “蓝、蓝、红（azul, azul, rojo）！”毯子上是红蓝相间的花纹。

cells.en: “We all have to yell super loud like a rooster,” says Dora.
cells.cn: “我们要像公鸡一样大声叫。”Dora 说。

cells.en: “To give the dragons chili pepper dreams, say ‘dulces sueños.’”
cells.cn: “要给小龙送去辣椒梦，就说‘dulces sueños（好梦）’。”

S05E15.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Super Babies' Dream Adventure”.
S05E15.ending: In the end, the Super Babies wake the Dream Fairy and everyone gets happy dreams. My favorite part is ______.

S05E16.title: Pirate Treasure Hunt
S05E16.hook: 小猪想当一天海盗、参加寻宝比赛，Dora 和 Boots 陪它找到最后那棵棕榈树、歌唱桥，还要穿过猴子洞才能上海盗船。

cells.en: “Do you like pirates?” Dora, Boots and the piggy stand on the beach.
cells.cn: “你喜欢海盗吗？”Dora、Boots 和小猪站在沙滩上。

cells.en: “I wish I could be a pirate and be in the treasure hunt.”
cells.cn: “我真想当一天海盗，去参加寻宝比赛。”

cells.en: Map says, “Then through the monkey cave,” and shows the ship.
cells.cn: 地图说：“然后要穿过猴子洞。”还画出了海盗船。

cells.en: “These mermaids are hungry and want to be fed,” says Dora.
cells.cn: “这些美人鱼饿了，想吃东西。”Dora 说。

cells.en: “In Spanish we say ‘con permiso,’” Dora tells the piggy.
cells.cn: “西班牙语里我们说‘con permiso（借过）’。”Dora 告诉小猪。

cells.en: “Again!” The big stone face blocks the way to the cave.
cells.cn: “再来一次！”大石头脸挡住了去洞穴的路。

cells.en: At sunset they sail on the wooden ship to find the chest.
cells.cn: 太阳落山时，他们坐上木船去找宝箱。

cells.en: “Yay!” The pirate monkeys and the crew cheer on the ship.
cells.cn: “耶！”海盗猴子们和船员在船上欢呼。

cells.en: They pretend to be monkeys and sing to get through the cave.
cells.cn: 他们假装成猴子，一边唱一边穿过洞穴。

S05E16.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Pirate Treasure Hunt”.
S05E16.ending: In the end, they find the pirate treasure chest and everyone cheers. My favorite part is ______.

S05E17.title: First Day of School
S05E17.hook: 今天是 Boots 和 Tico 第一天上学校，路上要先过小河、从乌龟背上过去，Swiper 还跑来捣乱。

cells.en: “At our school we get to learn Spanish and English,” says Boots.
cells.cn: “在学校我们可以学西班牙语和英语。”Boots 说。

cells.en: Map says, “River, forest, school,” and then points the way.
cells.cn: 地图说：“小河、森林、学校。”然后指出了路。

cells.en: “Right, that's a frog!” They see a green frog on a log.
cells.cn: “对，那是一只青蛙！”他们看见木头上蹲着一只绿青蛙。

cells.en: “We have to look very carefully for them,” says Dora.
cells.cn: “我们得非常仔细地找它们。”Dora 说。

cells.en: “Which turtle should Boots ride?” There are three big turtles.
cells.cn: “Boots 该骑哪只乌龟呢？”草地上有三只大乌龟。

cells.en: “Let's take Boots and Tico to their first day of school ever.”
cells.cn: “我们带 Boots 和 Tico 去他们人生第一天的学校吧。”

cells.en: “Swiper, no swiping!” They stop the fox on the path.
cells.cn: “Swiper，不许偷！”他们在小路上拦住了这只狐狸。

cells.en: “My name is Dora,” she sings to her class at school.
cells.cn: “我叫 Dora。”她在学校对着全班唱。

cells.en: “Me llamo Tico!” Tico holds his new backpack and smiles.
cells.cn: “我叫 Tico（me llamo Tico）！”Tico 抱着新书包笑了。

S05E17.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “First Day of School”.
S05E17.ending: In the end, Boots and Tico get to school and say their names to the class. My favorite part is ______.

S05E18.title: Boots' Banana Wish
S05E18.hook: Boots 许了个香蕉愿望，香蕉堆成山，可要把香蕉送回爷爷的工坊，得先过巨怪的桥、再坐香蕉船。

cells.en: “Remember, Boots?” Dora stands by a big pile of bananas.
cells.cn: “还记得吗，Boots？”Dora 站在一大堆香蕉旁边。

cells.en: “Who do we ask for help when we don't know which way to go?”
cells.cn: “不知道路怎么走的时候，我们该找谁帮忙？”

cells.en: Map shows the troll bridge, the river and Abuelo's workshop.
cells.cn: 地图上是大桥、小河，还有爷爷的工坊。

cells.en: “We made it over the bridge. Check!” Dora and Boots cheer.
cells.cn: “我们过桥啦！打勾！”Dora 和 Boots 一起欢呼。

cells.en: Their friends sing “Bananas!” and hold ripe yellow bananas.
cells.cn: 朋友们唱着“Bananas！”，手里举着黄澄澄的香蕉。

cells.en: They come to the water and need a boat to the workshop.
cells.cn: 他们来到水边，要坐船才能到工坊。

cells.en: “Ooh-ooh, ah-ah!” The little animals run along the path.
cells.cn: “呜—呜，啊—啊！”小动物们沿着小路跑过去。

cells.en: “Say ‘pirate piggies,’” Dora and Boots call across the water.
cells.cn: “说‘海盗小猪’！”Dora 和 Boots 朝水面那边喊。

cells.en: At last they reach Abuelo's workshop and the banana machine.
cells.cn: 他们终于到了爷爷的工坊，那里有一台香蕉机器。

S05E18.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Boots' Banana Wish”.
S05E18.ending: In the end, Boots gets his bananas and they take them to Abuelo's workshop. My favorite part is ______.

S05E19.title: Dora Helps the Birthday Wizzle
S05E19.titleCn: 帮生日小巫师找回魔杖
S05E19.hook: 生日小巫师的许愿魔杖被吹跑了，蜡烛烧完前一定要找回来，Dora 和 Boots 得先追上星星，再穿过恐龙和独角兽森林。

cells.en: “And catch it, catch it, catch it!” Dora and Boots run after a star.
cells.cn: “快抓住它，抓住它！”Dora 和 Boots 追着一颗星星跑。

cells.en: “You have to say ‘Map,’” Dora tells Boots with a smile.
cells.cn: “你要说‘Map（地图）’。”Dora 笑着对 Boots 说。

cells.en: Map says, “Unicorn, dinosaurs, Wizzle Mountain.”
cells.cn: 地图说：“独角兽、恐龙、巫师山。”

cells.en: A pink dinosaur with a party hat dreams of a fire truck.
cells.cn: 一只戴着派对帽的粉红恐龙，正想着消防车。

cells.en: “So we've got to look for stars,” says Dora on the hill.
cells.cn: “所以我们得去找星星。”Dora 在山坡上说。

cells.en: A big purple rain cloud floats over them and starts to rain.
cells.cn: 一大片紫色的雨云飘到他们头顶，开始下雨了。

cells.en: “Hi. Hola.” Dora and Boots meet two dinosaurs at the cave.
cells.cn: “Hi，Hola。”Dora 和 Boots 在洞口遇见两只恐龙。

cells.en: White unicorns run through the green forest by the lake.
cells.cn: 白色的独角兽在湖边的绿森林里奔跑。

cells.en: “We brought the wishing wand back to the Wizzle!”
cells.cn: “我们把许愿魔杖带回来给巫师啦！”

S05E19.opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Dora Helps the Birthday Wizzle”.
S05E19.ending: In the end, they bring the wishing wand back to the Wizzle before his candles burn out. My favorite part is ______.
